a: Veha ka mashma lan, dehalach al mishanto – hu devaenan umedana, iddach – umedana name la baenan.
Shamat minna, shechiv mera shennittak mecholi lecholi – mattenato mattana? in, deamar rabbi elazar mishshemeh derav: shechiv mera shennittak mecholi lecholi – mattenato mattana.
Rabba verava la sevira lehu ha derav huna, gezera shemma yomru yesh get leachar mita.
Umi ikka midde, demiddeorayyta la have gitta, umishshum gezera sharenan eshet ish lealma?!
In, kol dimkaddesh addata derabbanan mekaddesh, veafkeinhu rabbanan lekiddushin minneh.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: tinach dekaddesh bechaspa, kaddesh bevia may ikka lememar? amar leh: shavveyu rabbanan livilato beilat zenut.
Tanu rabbanan: "ze gittich mehayyom, im matti mecholi ze", venafal habbayit alav o hikkisho nachash – eno get. "im lo eemod mecholi ze", venafal alav bayit o hikkisho nachash – hare ze get.
May shena resha umay shena sefa?
Shelachu mittam: achalo ari – en lanu.
Hahu gavra dezabben ara lechavreh, kabbel aleh kol unesa demityelid. lesof appiku ba nahara.
Ata lekammeh deravina, amar leh: zil shefi leh, deha kabbelt alach kol unesa demityelid. amar leh rav acha bar tachlifa leravina: unesa dela shechiach hu!
Iggalgal milleta, umeta lekammeh derava. amar lehu: unesa dela shechiach hu. etiveh ravina lerava: "im lo eemod mecholi ze", venafal alav bayit o hikkisho nachash – hare ze get!
Amar leh rava: veema meresha – eno get!
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: umishshum dekashya resha assefa – la motvinan teyuveta minna?
Amar leh: in, kevan dekashya resha assefa – la ittemar be midresha, umeshabbashta hi; zil batar sevara.
Rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua zevun shumeshme aggidda dinhar malka. agur mallache leabborinhu, kabbilu alayyhu kol unesa demityelid. lesof istechar nehar malka,
Amaru lehu: eguru chammare afkeinhu nihalan, deha kabbeltu alayychu kol unesa demityelid!
Ato lekammeh derava, amar lehu: kake chivvare meshallechi gelime deinashe, unesa dela shechiach hu.
Mishna lo tityayched immo ella bifne edim,
Afillu al pi eved afillu al pi shifcha; chutz mishshifchatah, mippene shellibbah gas bah beshifchatah.
Ma hi beotan hayyamim? rabbi yehuda omer:
b: Keeshet ish lechol devareha. rabbi yose omer: megoreshet veenah megoreshet.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: rauha shennityaychada immo baafela, o sheyyashna immo tachat margelot hammitta – en choshshin shemma nitasseku bedavar acher; vechoshshin mishshum zenut veen choshshin mishshum kiddushin. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: af choshshin mishshum kiddushin.

May kaamar? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu, hachi kaamar: rauha shennivala – choshshin mishshum kiddushin. natan lah kesafim – choshshin mishshum zenut, deamrinan: beetnannah natan lah; veen choshshin mishshum kiddushin. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: af bezo choshshin mishshum kiddushin.
Keman azla ha deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: machaloket – kesherauha shennivala, aval lo rauha shennivala – divre hakkol en tzericha hemennu get sheni? keman –
Kedivre hakkol.
Matkef la abbaye: midde kesafim katane?!
Ella amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: rauha shennivala – choshshin mishshum zenut, veen choshshin mishshum kiddushin. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: af choshshin mishshum kiddushin.
Keman azla ha deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: machaloket – kesherauha shennivala, aval lo rauha shennivala – divre hakkol en tzericha hemennu get sheni? keman –
Kerabbi yose berabbi yehuda.
Matkef la rava: im ken, may "af"?
Ella amar rava: hachi kaamar, rabbi yose bar rabbi yehuda omer: af lo rauha shennivala – choshshin mishshum kiddushin.
Keman azla ha deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: machaloket – kesherauha shennivala, aval lo rauha shennivala – divre hakkol enah tzericha hemennu get? keman –
Dela kechad.
Ma hi beotan hayyamim? rabbi yehuda omer: keeshet ish lechol devareha, rabbi yose omer: megoreshet veenah megoreshet:
Tana: uvilvad sheyyamut. ulechi mayet have gitta?! veha kayyma lan deen get leachar mita! amar rabba: beomer "meet sheani baolam".
Tanu rabbanan: yamim shebbenatayim – balah zakkay bimtziatah, uvemaase yadeha, uvahafarat nedareha; veyorshah,

a: Umittamme lah. kelalo shel davar: hare hi keishto lechol davar – ella sheenah tzericha hemennu get sheni, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi meir omer: beilatah teluya. rabbi yose omer: beilatah safek. vachachamim omrim: megoreshet veenah megoreshet, uvilvad sheyyamut.
May ikka ben rabbi meir lerabbi yose?
Amar rabbi yochanan: asham taluy ikka benayyhu; lerabbi meir – la mayyte asham taluy, ulerabbi yose – mayyte asham taluy.

Vachachamim omrim: megoreshet veenah megoreshet. chachamim hayeynu rabbi yose! ikka benayyhu derabbi zera – deamar rabbi zera amar rabba bar yirmeya amar shemuel: kol makom sheamru chachamim "megoreshet veenah megoreshet" – balah chayyayv bimzonoteha.
Mishna "hare ze gittich, al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz" – hare zo megoreshet, vetitten.
"Al menat shettitteni li mikkan vead sheloshim yom" – im natna lo betoch sheloshim yom, megoreshet; veim lav, enah megoreshet.
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: maase betzaydan, beechad sheamar leishto: "hare ze gittich, al menat shettitteni li itzteliti", veavda itztelito, veamru chachamim: titten lo et dameha.
Gemara may "vetitten"? rav huna amar: vehi titten. rav yehuda amar: lichshettitten.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu shennitkara hagget o sheavad; rav huna amar "vehi titten" – enah tzericha hemennu get sheni; rav yehuda amar "lichshettitten" – tzericha hemennu get sheni.

Utenan name gabbe kiddushin ki hay gavvna – ditnan: haomer leishsha: "hare at mekuddeshet li, al menat sheetten lich matayim zuz" – hare hi mekuddeshet, veyitten. veittemar: may "veyitten"? rav huna amar: vehu yitten. rav yehuda amar: lichsheyyitten.

May benayyhu: ikka benayyhu – sheppashta yadah vekibbela kiddushin meacher. rav huna amar "vehu yitten" – tenaa bealma hu, mekayyem tenaeh veazel. rav yehuda amar "lichsheyyitten" – lechi yahev la hu dehavu kiddushin, hasheta la havu kiddushin.
Utzericha; dei ashmeinan gabbe kiddushin, beha kaamar rav huna "vehu yitten" – mishshum dilkarova kaate; aval gabbe gerushin – dilrachoka kaate, ema mode leh lerav yehuda;
Vei ashmeinan gabbe gerushin; beha kaamar rav huna "vehi titten" – mishshum dela kesif lemitbea; aval gabbe kiddushin, dichsifa lemitbeeh, ema mode leh lerav yehuda.
Vei ashmeinan gabbe kiddushin; beha kaamar rav yehuda "lichsheyyitten" – mishshum dichsifa lemitbeeh; aval gabbe gerushin – dela kesif lemitbea, ema mode leh lerav huna;
Vei ashmeinan gabbe gerushin; beha kaamar rav yehuda "lichshettitten" – mishshum dilrachoka kaate; aval gabbe kiddushin – dilkarova kaate, ema mode leh lerav huna; tzericha.
Metivi: "hare ze gittich, al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz", af al pi shennikra hagget o shenneevad – megoreshet; uleacher lo tinnase ad shettitten.

Veod tanya: "hare ze gittich, al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz", vamet, natna – enah zekuka leyavam; lo natna – zekuka leyavam. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: notenet leaviv o leachiv o leechad min hakkerovim.
Ad kan la peligi – ella demar savar: "li" – vela leyorshay, umar savar: "li" – vaafillu leyorshay; vechulle alma miha tenaa have – teyuveta derav yehuda!
Amar lach rav yehuda: ha manni, rabbi hi – deamar rav huna amar rabbi: kol haomer "al menat" keomer "meachshav" dame. ufeligi rabbanan aleh, vaana daamari kerabbanan.

Veamar rabbi zera: ki havenan bevavel amrinan, ha deamar rav huna amar rabbi: kol haomer "al menat" keomer "meachshav" dame – peligi rabbanan aleh. ki seliki, ashkachteh lerabbi assi deyatev vekaamar mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: hakkol modim beomer "al menat" – keomer "meachshav" dame. lo nechleku ella bemehayyom uleachar mita".
b: Vehatanya: "mehayyom uleachar mita" – get veeno get, divre chachamim; rabbi omer: kaze – get.
Ulerav yehuda – deamar: beal menat" peligi, addemippalgi bemehayyom uleachar mita", (lippalgi) [lippalgu] beal menat"! lehodiacha kocho derabbi.
Velippalgu beal menat" – ulehodiacha kochan derabbanan! koach dehettera adif leh.
"Al menat shettitteni li mikkan vead sheloshim yom" vechulei. peshita! mahu detema kefideh lav kefida – ulezaroza kaate; ka mashma lan.
Amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: maase betzaydan kulei. may tanna dekatane maase?

Chassore michassera, vehachi katane: im amar lah: "al menat shettitteni li itzteliti", veavda itztelito – itzteliti davka kaamar la. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: titten lo et dameha. veamar rabban shimon ben gamliel: maase name betzaydan, beechad sheamar leishto: "hare ze gittich al menat shettitteni li itzteliti", veavda itztelito, veamru chachamim: titten lo et dameha.
Bea minneh rabbi assi merabbi yochanan: "hare ze gittich al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz", vechazar veamar lah "mechulim lach", mahu?
Tibbee lerabbanan; tibbee lerabban shimon ben gamliel.

Tibbee lerabbanan – ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam, ella dela achala gabbah; aval hacha, ha kaamar la: "mechulim lach"; o dilma, afillu rabban shimon ben gamliel la kaamar, ella deka mefayyeysa leh bidme; aval ligmare – la. amar leh: enah megoreshet.

Etiveh: haomer lachavero: "kuvnnam sheatta nehene li, im i atta noten livni kor echad shel chittin ushete chaviyyot shel yayin", rabbi meir omer: asur ad sheyyitten; vachachamim omrim: af ze – yachol lehattir et nidro shello al pi chacham, veomer: "hareni keillu hitkabbalti"!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam letzaora ka mechavven – vela tzayara. hacha mishshum harevavcha hu, veha la itzterich.
Hahu gavra daamar leh laariseh: kulle alma delu telat dalavota, veachli riva; at deli arbea, veechol tilta. lesof ata mitra.
Amar rav yosef: ha la dela. rabba amar: ha la itztericha.
Lema rav yosef deamar kerabbanan, verabba deamar kerabban shimon ben gamliel?
Vetisbera?! veha kayyma lan hilcheta kevoteh derabba; uveha – en halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel!

Ella leolam kerabbanan. rav yosef – kerabbanan; verabba amar lach: ana daamari afillu lerabbanan, ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam – ella diltzaora ka mikkavven; aval hacha, mishshum harevavcha hu, veha la itzterich.

Tenan hatam: barishona haya nitman yom shenem asar chodesh, kede sheyyehe chalut lo. hitkin hillel hazzaken sheyyehe cholesh et meotav lallishka, vihe shover et haddelet venichnas. veematay sheyyirtze halla, yavo veyittol et meotav.
Veamar rava: mittakkanato shel hillel nishma – "hare ze gittich al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz", venatna lo middato, megoreshet; al korcho, enah megoreshet –
Middeitzterich leh lehillel letakkone netina beal kurecheh – dehavya la netina,

a: Mikkelal divalma, netina beal kurcheh la havya netina.
Matkef la rav pappa, veittema rav shimi bar ashe: vedilma ki itzterich leh letakkone – shello befanav, aval befanav – ben middato ben beal korcho havya netina!

Veikka deamri, amar rava: mittakkanato shel hillel – "hare ze gittech al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz", unetanah lo – ben middato uven beal korcho havya netina; vechi itzterich leh lehillel letakkone – shello befanav, aval befanav – ben middato ben beal korcho havya netina.
Matkef la rav pappa, veittema rav shimi bar ashe: vedilma afillu befanav name – middato in, al korcho la; vehillel – may deitzterich leh takken.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom sheshshana rabban shimon ben gamliel bemishnatenu – halacha kemoto; chutz mearev, vetzaydan,
Ureaya acharona.
Tanu rabbanan: "hare ze gittich, vehanneyayr shelli" – enah megoreshet. "al menat shettachziri li et hanneyayr" – megoreshet.
May shena resha umay shena sefa? amar rav chisda: ha manni – rabban shimon ben gamliel hi, deamar: titten lo et dameha; hacha name – efshar dimfayyeysa leh bidme.
Matkef la abbaye: emor deamar rabban shimon ben gamliel – hecha deleteh beeneh, hecha deiteh beeneh mi amar?!
Ella amar abbaye: ha manni – rabbi meir hi, deamar: baenan tenay kaful; vehacha – ha la kafleh litnaeh.
Matkef la rava: tama dela kafleh litnaeh, ha kafleh litnaeh – la have gitta; mikkede kol tenae mehecha gamrinan lehu? mittenay bene gad uvene reuven;
Ma hatam – tenay kodem lemaase, af kol tenay kodem lemaase; leappoke hacha – demaase kodem litnay!
Ella amar rava: mishshum demaase kodem litnay.

Matkef la rav adda bar ahava: tama demaase kodem litnay, ha tenay kodem lemaase – la have gitta; mikkede kol tenae mehecha gamrinan lehu – mittenay bene gad uvene reuven, ma hatam – tenay bedavar echad umaase bedavar acher, af kol; leappoke hacha –
b: Ditnay umaase bedavar echad! ella amar rav adda bar ahava: mishshum ditnay umaase bedavar echad.
Rav ashe amar: ha manni – rabbi hi, deamar rav huna amar rav: kol haomer "al menat" keomer "meachshav" dame.
Atken shemuel begitta dishchiv mera: "im lo matti lo yehe get, veim matti yehe get".
Velema: "im matti yehe get, veim lo matti lo yehe get"! la makdem inish pureanuta lenafsheh.
Velema: "lo yehe get im lo matti"! baenan tenay kodem lemaase.
Matkef la rava: mikkede kol tenae mehecha gamrinan – mittenay bene gad uvene reuven; ma hatam – hen kodem lelav, af kol [tenae, hen kodem lelav].
Ella amar rava: "im lo matti lo yehe get, im matti yehe get, im lo matti lo yehe get" –
"Im lo matti lo yehe get" – la makdem inish pureanuta lenafsheh; "im matti yehe get, im lo matti lo yehe get" – baenan hen kodem lelav.

Mishna "hare ze gittich al menat shetteshammeshi et abba"; "al menat shettaniki et beni" – kamma hi menikato? shete shanim. rabbi yehuda omer: shemona asar chodesh. met habben o shemmet haav – hare ze get.
"Hare ze gittich al menat shetteshammeshi et abba shete shanim"; "al menat shettaniki et beni shete shanim" – met habben, o sheamar haav: "i efshi shetteshammesheni" shello behakepada – eno get.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: kaze – get. kelal amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: kol akkava sheenah hemenna – hare ze get.
Gemara umi baenan kulle hay?! ureminhi: shimmeshattu yom echad; henikattu yom echad – hare ze get!
Amar rav chisda, la kashya: ha rabbanan, veha rabban shimon ben gamliel –
Matnitin rabban shimon ben gamliel, uvarayyta rabbanan.
Ha middesefa rabban shimon ben gamliel have, mikkelal deresha lav rabban shimon ben gamliel! ella barayyta – rabban shimon ben gamliel hi, demekel bitnae; matnitin – rabbanan.
Rava amar, la kashya: kan bistam, kan bimfaresh.
Rav ashe amar: kol setam name kimfaresh "yom echad" dame.
Tenan: kamma hi menikato? shete shanim. rabbi yehuda omer: shemona asar chodesh. bishlama lerava – nicha; ella lerav ashe, lema li shete shanim? lema li shemona asar chodesh? beyom echad saggi!
Hachi kaamar: yom echad – mishte shanim; leappoke leachar shete shanim – dela. yom echad – mishshemona asar chodesh; leappoke leachar shemona asar chodesh – dela.

Metivi: "hare ze gittich al menat shetteshammeshi et abba shete shanim"; "al menat shettaniki et beni shete shanim" – met habben, o sheamar haav "i efshi shetteshammesheni" shello behakepada – eno get.

a: Bishlama lerava – resha bidla paresh, sefa defaresh.
Ella lerav ashe – may shena resha, umay shena sefa? kashya.

Tanu rabbanan: "hare ze gittich al menat shetteshammeshi et abba shete shanim", veal menat shettaniki et beni shete shanim" – af al pi shello nitkayyem hattenay, hare ze get; lefi shello amar lah: "im teshammeshi – im lo teshammeshi"; "im taniki – veim lo taniki"; divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: nitkayyem hattenay – hare ze get, veim lav – eno get. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: en lecha tenay bakketuvim, sheeno kaful.

Ikka deamri: lerabbi meir kaamar leh; veikka deamri: lerabbanan kaamar lehu. ikka deamri lerabbi meir kaamar leh – vehachi kaamar leh: en lecha tenay bakketuvim sheeno kaful, vehavu lehu shene chetuvim habbain keechad, vechol shene chetuvim habbain keechad – en melammedin.
Ikka deamri lerabbanan kaamar lehu – vehachi kaamar lehu: in lach tenay bakketuvim sheeno kaful, vegamrinan minnayyhu.
Ureminhu: "hare ze gittich al menat shetteshammeshi et abba shete shanim"; "al menat shettaniki et beni shete shanim" – met haav o met habben, eno get; divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: af al pi shello nitkayyem hattenay, hare ze get – yechola hi shettomar lo: "ten li avicha, vaashammeshennu"; "ten li bincha, vaanikennu".
Kashya derabbi meir adderabbi meir, kashya derabbanan adderabbanan!
Derabbi meir adderabbi meir la kashya – hatam bidla kafleh litnaeh, hacha bidchafleh litnaeh.
Verabbanan adderabbanan la kashya, man chachamim dehacha – rabban shimon ben gamliel hi, deamar: kol akkava sheenah hemenna, hare ze get.

Tanu rabbanan, amar lah bifne shenayim: "hare ze gittich al menat shetteshammeshi et abba shete shanim", vechazar veamar lah bifne shenayim: "hare ze gittich al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz" – lo bittel divre haacharon et harishon; ratzta – meshammashto, ratzta – notenet lo matayim zuz.

Aval amar lah bifne shenayim: "hare ze gittich al menat shettitteni li matayim zuz", vechazar veamar lah bifne shenayim: "hare ze gittich al menat shettitteni li shelosh meot zuz" – bittel divre haacharon et harishon; veen echad min harishonim veechad min haacharonim mitztarfin.
Aheyay? illema assefa – hare batel! ella aresha –
Peshita! mahu detema, kol lekayyome tenay – mitztarfin; ka mashma lan.
Mishna "hare ze gittich im lo bati mikkan ad sheloshim yom", vehaya holech mihuda laggalil; higgia leantifras vechazar – batel tenao.
"Hare ze gittich im lo bati mikkan ad sheloshim yom", vehaya holech miggalil lihuda, vehiggia lichfar otnay vechazar – batel tenao.
"Hare ze gittich im lo bati mikkan ad sheloshim yom", vehaya holech limdinat hayyam, vehiggia leakko vechazar – batel tenao.
"Hare ze gittich kol zeman sheeevor mikkeneged panayich sheloshim yom"; haya holech uva, holech uva, hoil velo nityached immah – hare ze get.
Gemara lememra deantifras begalil hava kayyma?! ureminhi: antifras – bihuda; uchefar otnay – baggalil; bentayim – metilin oto lechumera, megoreshet
b: Veenah megoreshet!

Amar abbaye, tere tenae kaamar la: i matena legalil – lealtar leheve gitta, vei mishtahena beorcha telatin yomin vela atena – leheve gitta. higgia leantifras vechazar – dela legalil meta, vela ishtahoye name ishtahi telatin yomin – batel tenao.

"Hare ze gittich im lo bati mikkan vead sheloshim yom" kulei: lememra deakko bimdinat hayyam kayyma?! veha amar rav safra: ki havo mippatri rabbanan mehadade – beakko havo mippatri, mishshum deasur latzet mearetz lechutza laaretz!

Amar abbaye, tere tenae kaamar la: i matena limdinat hayyam – lealtar leheve gitta, i mishtahena beorcha telatin yomin vela atena – leheve gitta. higgia leakko vechazar – dela limdinat hayyam meta, vela ishtahoye name ishtahi telatin yomin – batel tenao.
"Hare ze gittich kol zeman sheeevor" vechulei: veha la avar! amar rav huna: may "panayich" – tashmish; veammay kare leh "panayich" – lishshana mealleya naket.
Verabbi yochanan amar: leolam "panayich" mammash. mi katane "hare zo megoreshet"? "hare ze get" katane – dela have get yashan, ulechi malu telatin yome have gitta.

Tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: "hare ze gittich kol zeman sheeevor minneged panayich sheloshim yom", vehaya holech uva, holech uva; hoil velo nityayched immah – hare ze get; uleget yashan en choshshin, shehare lo nityayched immah.
Velechush shemma piyyes! amar rabba bar rav huna: hachi amar abba mari mishshemeh derav, beomer: neemenet alay lomar shello bati.

Ikka dematne la ammatnitin: "meachshav im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh", umet betoch shenem asar chodesh – hare ze get. velechush shemma piyyes! amar rabba bar rav huna: hachi amar abba mari mishshemeh derav, beomer: neemenet alay lomar shello bati.
Man dematne la ammatnitin, kol shekken abbarayyta.
Man dematne la abbarayyta – aval ammatnitin, ha la ata.
Mishna "hare ze gittich, im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh", umet betoch shenem asar chodesh – eno get.
"Hare ze gittich meachshav, im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh", umet betoch shenem asar chodesh – hare ze get.
"Im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh, kitvu utenu get leishti" – katvu get betoch shenem asar chodesh, venatnu leachar shenem asar chodesh – eno get.
"Kitvu utenu get leishti, im lo bati mikkan ad shenem asar chodesh" – katvu betoch shenem asar chodesh, venatnu leachar shenem asar chodesh – eno get. rabbi yose omer: kaze – get.

Katvu leachar shenem asar chodesh, venatnu leachar shenem asar chodesh, vamet; im hagget kodem lammita – hare ze get; veim mita kadma lagget – eno get; veim en yadua – zo hi sheamru megoreshet veenah megoreshet.
Gemara tana: rabbotenu hittiruha linnase.
Man rabbotenu? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: be dina dishro mishcha; savri la kerabbi yose, deamar: zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav.
Amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi yehuda nesia beno shel rabban gamliel bar rabbi hora, velo hodu lo kol siato; veamri lah kol sheato.

Amar leh rabbi elazar lehahu sava: ki sherituha – lealtar sherituha, o leachar shenem asar chodesh sherituha? lealtar sherituha – deha la ate; o dilma, leachar shenem asar chodesh sherituha – deha ikkayyaym leh tenao?

Vetibbee leh matnitin: "meachshav, im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh", umet betoch shenem asar chodesh – hare ze get. lealtar have, deha la ate; o dilma, leachar shenem asar chodesh – deha ikkayyaym leh tenaeh? in hachi name, umishshum dahava behahu maase.
Amar abbaye: hakkol modim hecha deamar: "lichshettetze chamma minnartikah" –

a: Lechi nafka kaamar lah, vechi mayet belelya – have get leachar mita.
"Al menat shettetze chamma minnartikah" – meachshav kaamar la, deamar rav huna amar rav: kol haomer "al menat" keomer "meachshav" dame.

Lo nechleku ella beim tetze" – mar savar la kerabbi yose, deamar: zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav, vehave leh kemehayyom im matti", kemeachshav im matti"; mar la savar kerabbi yose, vehave leh keim matti" gereda.
"Kitvu utenu get leishti, im lo bati mikkan vead shenem asar chodesh" – katvu kulei.

Amar leh rav yemar lerav ashe: lema kasavar rabbi yose katav get al tenay – kasher? la; leolam ema lach pasul, veshane hacha – middahava leh lememar: "im lo bati kitvu utenu"; veamar: "kitvu utenu im lo bati"; hachi kaamar: kitvu meachshav, utenu im lo bati. verabbanan – la shena hachi vela shena hachi.
Tanu rabbanan: "leachar shavua" – shana; "leachar shana" – chodesh; "leachar chodesh" – shabbat.

"Leachar shabbat", may? yatev rabbi zera kammeh derabbi assi, veamri la rabbi assi kammeh derabbi yochanan, vekaamar: chad beshabba, utere, utelata – batar shabbeta. arbea, vechamsha umaale shabbeta – kamme shabbeta.
Tanya, rabbi omer: "leachar haregel" – sheloshim yom. nefak rabbi chiyyay darsha mishshemeh derabbi – vekallesu; mishshemeh derabbim – vela kallesu; alma let hilcheta kevoteh.
Hadaran alach mi sheachazo

Hazzorek get leishto, vehi betoch betah o betoch chatzerah – hare zo megoreshet. zerako lah betoch beto o betoch chatzero, afillu hu immah bammitta – enah megoreshet. letoch chekah o letoch kaltah – hare zo megoreshet.
Gemara mena hane mille? detanu rabbanan: "venatan beyadah" – en li ella yadah; gaggah, chatzerah vekarpefah – minnayin? talmud lomar: "venatan" – mikkol makom.
Vetanya name hachi gabbe gannav: "yado" – en li ella yado; gaggo, chatzero vekarpefo – minnayin? talmud lomar: "himmatze timmatze" – mikkol makom.
Utzericha; dei ashmoinan get – mishshum dival kurcha miggarsha; aval gannav – deleteh beal kurecheh, ema la;
Vei ashmoinan gannav – mishshum dekanseh rachamana; aval get – ema la, tzericha.
Chatzerah?! ma shekkanta ishsha kana balah!
Amar rabbi elazar, bechotev lah: "din udevarim en li binchasayich".
Vechi ketav la hachi – may have? vehatanya, haomer lachavero: "din udevarim en li al sade zo"; veen li esek bah"; veyadi mesulleket hemenna" – lo amar kelum!
Amri deve rabbi yannay: bechotev lah – veodah arusa, vechidrav kahana – deamar rav kahana: nachala habbaa lo leadam mimmakom acher, adam matne aleha shello yirashenna;
Vechidrava – deamar rava, haomer:
b: I efshi betakkanat chachamim kegon zo – shomin lo.
May "kegon zo"? kidrav huna amar rav – deamar rav huna amar rav: yechola ishsha shettomar levalah: "eni nizzonet veeni osa".
Rava amar: attu yadah mi la kanya leh levaal?! ella gittah veyadah bain keechad; hacha name – gittah vachatzerah bain keechad.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: rava – yad deishsha ka kashya leh?! nehi dekane la lemaase yadeha, yadah gufa mi kanya[1] leh?!
Amar leh: rava – yad haeved ka kashya leh; leman deamar: bishtar – al yede atzmo, yad eved keyad rabbo damya! ella gitto veyado bain keechad; hachi name – gittah vachatzerah bain keechad.

Hahu shechiv mera dichtav la gitta lidvethu bahade panya demaale shabbeta, velo hispik lemitteveh la. limchar, tekaf leh alma. ato lekammeh derava, amar lehu: zilu emaru leh, laykneyeh nihala lehahu ducheta deyatev beh gitta, vetezil ihi vetechod vetiftach vetachzek beh.
Ditnan: naal, gadar, paratz kol shehu – hare zo chazaka.
Amar leh rav ilish lerava: ma shekkanta ishsha kana balah! ikkesif.
Lesof iggallay milleta daarusa havay. amar rava: im amru binsua, yomru baarusa?! hadar amar rava: la shena arusa vela shena nesua – gittah vachatzerah bain keechad.
Veha amra rava meikkara! ki amra rava – ahay maase amra.
Vehi betoch betah. amar ulla: vehu sheomedet betzad betah uvetzad chatzerah. rabbi oshaya amar: afillu hi bitverya vachatzerah betzippori; hi betzippori vachatzerah bitverya – megoreshet.
Veha "hi betoch betah uvetoch chatzerah" katane! hachi kaamar: "vehi kemi shebbetoch betah"; "vehi kemi shebbetoch chatzerah" – dechevan dechatzer mishtammeret ledatah hi, mitgareshet.
Lema beha kamippalgi – demar savar: chatzer mishshum yadah itrabbay; umar savar: chatzer mishshum shelichut itrabbay?
La; dechulle alma – chatzer mishshum yadah itrebay; mar savar: keyadah – ma yadah bismucha, af chatzerah bismucha.
Veiddach – i, ma yadah bidvuka, af chatzerah bidvuka?! ella keyadah – ma yadah mishtammeret ledatah, af chatzerah hammishtammeret ledatah; leappoke chatzerah hammishtammeret shello ledatah.

Hahu gavra dizrak la gitta lidvethu. hava kayyma bechatzer. azal gitta, nefal befisla. amar rav yosef: chazenan, i havya arba ammot al arba ammot – pelag leh reshuta lenafsheh; vei la – chada reshuta hi.
Bemay askinan? ilema bechatzer dida, ki have arba ammot may have? ella bechatzer dideh, ki la have arba ammot may have?
La tzericha, deoshla makom; dechad makom moshli inashe, tere mekomot la moshli inashe.
Vela amaran ella delo gavoah asara, aval gavoah asara – af al gav dela have arba ammot.
Vela amaran ella delet leh

a: Shem levavy, aval it leh shem levavy – af al gav delo gavoah asara, veaf al gav dela have arba ammot.
Afillu hu immah bammitta kulei: amar rava: lo shanu ella bemitta shello, aval bemitta shellah – megoreshet.
Tanya name hachi, rabbi eliezer omer: bemitta shello – enah megoreshet, bemitta shellah – megoreshet.
Uvemitta shellah – megoreshet? kilyo shel lokeach birshut mocher hu; shamat minna: kilyo shel lokeach birshut mocher – kana lokeach?
La tzericha, degavoah asara. vehaikka mekom kare! ammekom kare la kafdi inashe.
Letoch chekah o letoch kaltah – megoreshet: ammay? kilyo shel lokeach birshut mocher hu!

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kegon shehayta kaltah teluya bah. vechen amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: kegon shehayta kaltah teluya bah. verabbi shimon ben lakish amar: keshura, af al pi sheenah teluya.
Rav adda bar ahava amar: kegon shehayta kaltah munnachat lah ben yarchoteha. rav mesharsheya bar rav dimi amar: kegon shehaya balah mocher kelatot.
Rabbi yochanan amar: mekom chekah kanuy lah, mekom kaltah kanuy lah. amar rava: may tama derabbi yochanan? lefi sheen adam makpid lo al mekom chekah velo al mekom kaltah.
Tanya name hachi: zerako lah letoch chekah o letoch kaltah, o letoch kol davar shehu kekaltah – hare zo megoreshet.
"Kol davar shehu kekaltah" – leetoye may? leetoye taska deachla ba tamre.
Mishna amar lah: "kinsi shetar chov ze", o shemmetzaattu meachorav, kora vahare hu gittah – eno get, ad sheyyomar la: "he gittich".
Natan beyadah vehi yeshena; neora, kora, vahare hu gittah – eno get, ad sheyyomar lah "he gittich".
Gemara ki amar la: "he gittich" may have? have leh "teli gittich meal gabbe karka",
Veamar rava: "teli gittich meal gabbe karka" – lo amar kelum! ema: sheshshelafattu meachorav.
Shelafattu name, ha baena "venatan beyadah", velekka! la tzericha, daarak la chartzeh, ushelafteh.

Tanya name hachi: amar lah "kinsi shetar chov ze", o sheshshelafattu meachorav, keraattu vahare hu gittah – eno get, ad sheyyomar lah "he gittich", divre rabbi. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: leolam eno get, ad sheyyittelennu hemenna, veyachazor veyittenennu lah, veyomar lah "he gittich".

Netano beyadah vehi yeshena, neora vekora vahare hu gittah – eno get, ad sheyyomar lah: "he gittich", divre rabbi. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: ad sheyyittelennu hemenna, veyachazor veyittenennu lah, veyomar lah "he gittich".
Utzericha; dei ittemar behach kammayyta, behahi kaamar rabbi – mishshum devat iggaroshe hi; aval natan beyadah vehi yeshena, delav bat iggaroshe hi – ema mode leh lerabbi shimon ben elazar;
Vei ittemar beha, beha kaamar rabbi shimon ben elazar; aval behach – ema mode leh lerabbi; tzericha.
Amar rava: katav lah get, unetano beyad avdah yashen, umeshammarto – hare ze get. neor – eno get, dehavya lay chatzer hammishtammeret shello ledatah.
Yashen umeshammarto – hare ze get. ammay? chatzer mehallechet hi, vechatzer mehallechet lo kana!
Vechi tema yashen shane, veha amar rava: kol sheillu mehallech lo kana, omed veyoshev – lo kana! vehilcheta: bechafut.
Mishna hayta omedet birshut harabbim uzerako lah; karov lah – megoreshet. karov lo – enah megoreshet. mechetza al mechetza – megoreshet veenah megoreshet. vechen leinyan kiddushin.
Vechen leinyan hachov, amar lo baal chovo: "zerok li chovi", uzerako lo; karov lammalve – zacha hammalve. karov lallove – hallove chayyayv. mechetza al mechetza – shenehem yachloku.
Gemara hechi dame karov lah, vehechi dame karov lo? amar rav: arba ammot shellah – zehu karov lah, arba ammot shello – zehu karov lo.
Hechi dame mechetza al mechetza? amar rabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak: kegon shehayu shenehen omdin bearba ammot.
Velichze he minnayyhu kedem! vechi tema daato tarvayyhu bahade hadade, veha i efshar letzamtzem!
Ella amar rav kahana: hacha bishmone ammot metzumetzamot askinan,
b: Veget yotze mearba ammot shello learba ammot shellah.
Veha agid gabbeh! ella rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: hacha bishte kitte edim askinan – achat omeret karov lo, veachat omeret karov lah.
Rabbi yochanan omer: "karov lah" shaninu – afillu mea amma; vekarov lo" shaninu – afillu mea amma.

Hechi dame mechetza al mechetza? amar rav shemen bar abba, ledidi mipparsha la minneh derabbi yochanan: hu yachol leshomro vehi enah yechola leshomro – zehu karov lo; hi yechola leshomro vehu eno yachol leshomro – zehu karov lah; shenehem yecholin leshomro, shenehem en yecholin – zehu mechetza al mechetza.
Amruha rabbanan kammeh derabbi yochanan mishshemeh derabbi yonatan hachi, amar: yadin chavrin bavlae lefaroshe ki hay tama!
Tanya name hachi, rabbi eliezer omer: kol shehu karov lah millo, uva kelev unetalo – enah megoreshet. enah megoreshet?! kol haychi tintereh vetezil?
Ella lav hachi kaamar: kol shekkarov lah millo; veillu ba kelev unetalo – vehu yachol leshomro vehi enah yechola leshomro, enah megoreshet.
Amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, kede shettashuach vetittelennu. veat la taaved ovada, ad demate gitta lida.
Amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe: hava ovada hachi, veatzrechuha chalitza.
Vechen leinyan kiddushin. amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: legittin amru, velo ledavar acher.
Etiveh rabbi abba lerabbi assi: vechen leinyan kiddushin! shane hatam dichtiv "veyatza"–"vehayta".
Etiveh: vechen leinyan hachov, "zerok li chovi" uzerako lo, karov lammalve – zacha hallove, karov lallove – hallove chayyayv, mechetza al mechetza – shenehem yachloku!
Hacha bemay askinan – daamar leh: "zerok li chovi vetippater". i hachi may lememra? la tzericha, daamar leh: "zerok li chovi betorat gittin".
Veakkatti, may lememra? mahu detema, matze amar leh meshatte ani bach; ka mashma lan.
Amar rav chisda: get beyadah umeshicha beyado; im yachol lenatteko velahavio etzlo – enah megoreshet, veim lav – megoreshet.
May tama? baenan keritut, velekka.
Amar rav yehuda: hayta yadah asuya kekatafres, uzerako lah; af al pi shehiggia get leyadah – enah megoreshet.
Ammay? ha ki nafel – bearba ammot dida ka nafel! bidla nach.
Vetiggarash meavvera dearba ammot! tifshot devae rabbi elazar – arba ammot sheamru, yesh lahen avir o en lahen avir? tifshot deen lahen avir!
Hacha bemay askinan – beomedet al gav hannahar, demeikkara leibbud kae.

a: Mishna hayta omedet al rosh haggag uzerako lah, kevan shehiggia laavir haggag – hare zo megoreshet. hu millemala vehi millematta, uzerako lah, kevan sheyyatza mershut haggag, nimchak o nisraf – hare zo megoreshet.
Gemara veha la minnetar! amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: begag sheyyesh lo maake askinan.
Ulla bar menashsheya mishshemeh daavimi amar: hacha befachot mishshelosha samuch laggag askinan, dechol pachot mishshelosha samuch laggag – kegag dame.
Hu millemala: veha la minnetar! amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kegon shehayu mechitzot hattachtonot odfot al haelyonot.
Vechen amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: kegon shehayu mechitzot hattachtonot odfot al haelyonot. vechen amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: kegon shehayu mechitzot hattachtonot odfot al haelyonot.
Amar leh rabbi abba leulla: keman, kerabbi – deamar: keluta, kemi shehunnecha damya?
Amar leh: afillu tema rabbanan – ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi, ella leinyan shabbat; aval hacha – mishshum innetore hu, veha ka minnetar.
Vechen amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: kegon shehayu mechitzot hattachtonot odfot al haelyonot. amar leh rabbi zera lerabbi assi: keman, kerabbi – deamar: keluta kemi shehunnecha damya?
Amar leh: afillu tema rabbanan – ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi, ella leinyan shabbat; aval hacha – mishshum innetore hu, veha ka minnetar.
Nimchak: amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo shanu ella shennimchak derech yerida, aval nimchak derech aliyyay – la. may tama? meikkara la lemenach kae.
Nisraf: amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo shanu ella shekkadam get lidleka, aval kadma deleka leget – la. may tama? meikkara lisrefa kaazel.
Amar rav chisda: reshuyot chalukot begittin.
Amar leh rame bar chama lerava: mena leh lesava ha? amar leh, matnitin hi: hayta omedet al rosh haggag uzerako lah, kevan shehiggia get laavir haggag – hare zo megoreshet.
Bemay askinan? ilema begag dida vechatzer dida, lema li avir haggag?
Ella begag dideh vechatzer dideh, ki higgia laavir haggag may have?

Ella peshita – begag dida vechatzer dideh. ema sefa: hu millemala vehi millematta uzerako lah; kevan sheyyatza mershut haggag, nimchak o nisraf – hare zo megoreshet. vei begag dida vechatzer dideh, ammay megoreshet? ella begag dideh vechatzer dida;
Resha begag dida vechatzer dideh, sefa begag dideh vechatzer dida?!
Ella lav deoshla makom – dechad makom moshli inashe, tere mekomot la moshli inashe?
Amar leh: mide irya?! dilma ha kidita veha kidita – resha begag dida vechatzer dideh, sefa begag dideh vechatzer dida.
Amar rava: shalosh middot begittin; ha deamar rabbi: keluta kemi shehunnecha, ufeligi rabbanan aleha – hane mille leinyan shabbat, aval hacha mishshum innetore hu, veha minnetar;

Veha deamar rav chisda: naatz kane birshut hayyachid uverosho teraskal, vezarak venach al gabbav – afillu gavoah mea amma, chayyayv, lefi shershut hayyachid ola ad larakia – hane mille leinyan shabbat, aval hacha mishshum innetore hu, veha la minnetar;
b: Veha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: lo yaamod adam begag ze veyiklot me geshamim miggaggo shel chavero, shekkeshem sheddiyyurin chalukin millematta, kach diyyurin chalukin millemala –
Hane mille leinyan shabbat, aval leinyan get – mishshum kefida hu, vechulle hay la kafdi inashe.

Amar abbaye: shete chatzerot zo lifnim mizzo, penimit shellah vechitzona shello, umechitzot hachitzonot odfot al happenimiyyot; uzerako lah; kevan shehiggia laavir mechitzot hachitzona – hare zo megoreshet.
May tama? penimit gufa – bimchitzot hachitzona ka minnatra.
Ma sheen ken bekuppot – shete kuppot zo betoch zo, penimit shellah vechitzona shello; uzerako lah; afillu higgia laavir penimit – enah megoreshet.
May tama? deha la nach.
Vechi nach may have? kilyo shel lokeach birshut mocher hu!
Hacha bemay askinan – bekuppa sheen lah shulayim.
Mishna bet shammay omrim: poter adam ishto beget yashan. uvet hillel osrin. veezehu get yashan – kol shennityayched immah meachar shekketavo lah.
Gemara bemay kamippalgi? bet shammay savri: la amrinan gezera shemma yomru gittah kodem livnah;
Uvet hillel savri: amrinan gezera shemma yomru gittah kodem livnah.
Amar rabbi abba amar shemuel: im nisset, lo tetze.
Veikka deamri, amar rabbi abba amar shemuel: im nitgarsha, tinnase lechattechilla.
Mishna katav leshum malchut sheenah hogenet; leshum malchut maday; leshum malchut yavan; levinyan habbayit; lechureban habbayit;
Haya bammizrach vechatav bammaarav; bammaarav vechatav bammizrach – tetze mizze umizze, utzericha get mizze umizze.
Veen lah lo ketubba velo perot velo mezonot velo belaot – lo al ze, velo al ze.
Im natla mizze umizze – tachzir. vehavvalad mamzer mizze umizze. velo ze vaze metammein lah, velo ze vaze zakkain – lo bimtziatah velo bemaase yadeha velo bahafarat nedareha.
Hayta bat yisrael – nifselet min hakkehunna.

a: Bat levi – min hammaaser. bat kohen – min hatteruma.
Veen yorshin shel ze veyorshin shel ze yorshim ketubbatah. veim metu – achiv shel ze veachiv shel ze choltzin, velo meyaybmin.
Shinna shemo, ushemah, shem iro, veshem irah – tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu bah.
Kol arayot sheamru "tzarotehen muttarot" –
Halchu hatztzarot haellu venisseu, venimtzeu ellu ayyloniyyot – tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu bah.
Hakkones et yevimto, vehalcha tzaratah venisset leacher, venimtzet zo – shehayta ayylonit; tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu bah.
Katav sofer get laish, veshovar laishsha; vetaa venatan get laishsha, veshovar laish, venatnu ze laze;
Uleachar zeman hare hagget yotze miyyad haish veshovar miyyad haishsha – tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu bah.
Rabbi elazar omer: im lealtar yatza, en ze get; im leachar zeman yatza, hare ze get – lo kol hemennu min harishon leabbed zechuto shel sheni.
Gemara may "malchut sheenah hogenet"? romi. veammay kare la malchut sheenah hogenet? mishshum deen lahem lo ketav, velo lashon.
Amar ulla: mippene ma tikkenu malchut begittin – mishshum shelom malchut.
Umishshum shelom malchut – tetze vehavvalad mamzer?!
In, rabbi meir letameh – deamar rav hamenuna mishshemeh deulla, omer haya rabbi meir: kol hameshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim begittin – havvalad mamzer.
Leshum malchut yavan. utzericha; dei ashmoinan malchut sheenah hogenet – mishshum dimlicha; aval malchut maday umalchut yavan – may dahava hava;
Vei ashmeinan malchut maday umalchut yavan – mishshum demalchevata havu; aval binyan habbayit – may dahava hava;
Vei ashmeinan binyan habbayit – deamri: kamadkeri shevachayyhu; aval chureban habbayit, detzaara hu – ema la; tzericha.
Haya bammizrach vechatav bammaarav: man? illema baal, hayeynu "shinna shemo ushemah, shem iro veshem irah"!

Ella lav sofer – kedaamar lehu rav lesafreh, vechen amar lehu rav huna lesafreh: ki yatvitu beshile, ketuvu beshile; veaf al gav demimmasran lechu mille behine. vechi yatvitu behine, ketuvu behine; veaf al gav demimmasran lechu mille beshile.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel:
b: Zo divre rabbi meir, aval chachamim omrim: afillu lo katav ella leshem santar shebbair – hare zo megoreshet.
Hahu gitta dahava ketiv beh leshem istandera devashkar, shalche rav nachman bar rav chisda lekammeh derabba: ki hay gavvna, may?
Shelach leh: beha afillu rabbi meir mode, may tama? meotah malchut hu.
Umay shena missantar shebbair? hatam zila lehu milleta, hacha shevicha lehu milleta.

Amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav: zo divre rabbi meir, aval chachamim omrim: havvalad kasher. umodim chachamim lerabbi meir, sheim shinna shemo ushemah, shem iro veshem irah – shehavvalad mamzer.
Amar rav ashe, af anan name tenena: shinna shemo ushemah, shem iro veshem irah – tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu bah.
Ha man katane la? illema rabbi meir – liarvinhu velitninhu! ella shema minna rabbanan; shema minna.
Kol arayot sheamru kulei. nisseu – en, zinnu – la;
Lema tehve teyuveta derav hamenuna – deamar rav hamenuna: shomeret yavam shezzinneta, asura livamah!
La; nisseu – vehu haddin lezinnu. vehay dekatane nisseu – lishshana mealleya naket.
Veikka deamri: nisseu – vehu haddin lezinnu;
Lema mesayyay leh lerav hamenuna – deamar rav hamenuna: shomeret yavam shezzinneta – asura livamah?
La; nisseu davvka, mishshum demichallefa beishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam.
Hakkones et yevimto kulei. utzericha; dei ashmeinan behach kammayyta – mishshum dela ikkayyaym mitzvat yibbum;
Aval hacha – deikkayyaym mitzvat yibbum, ema la;
Vei ashmeinan hacha – mishshum deka ramya kammeh; aval hatam – dela ramya kammeh, ema la; tzericha.
Katav hassofer vetaa, venatan get laishsha veshovar vechulei; rabbi eliezer omer im lealtar yatza vechulei.
Hechi dame lealtar, vehechi dame leachar zeman? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol zeman sheyyoshvin vaasukin beoto inyan – zehu lealtar; amdu – zehu leachar zeman.
Verav adda bar ahava amar: lo nisset – zehu lealtar; nisset – zehu leachar zeman.
Tenan: lo kol hemennu min harishon leabbed zechuto shel sheni. bishlama lerav adda bar ahava – hayeynu dekatane "sheni", ella lishmuel – may "sheni"?

a: Zechut haruya lashsheni.
Mishna katav legaresh et ishto, venimlach; bet shammay omrim: pesalah min hakkehunna. uvet hillel omrim: af al pi shennetano lah al tenay, velo naasa hattenay – lo pesalah min hakkehunna.
Gemara shelach leh rav yosef bereh derav menashshe middevil, lishmuel: yelammedenu rabbenu, yatza alav kol – "ish peloni kohen katav get leishto, veyoshevet tachtav umeshammashto", mahu?
Shelach leh: tetze, vehaddavar tzarich bedika. may hi? ilema dei mevattelinan kala o la mevattelinan; veha nehardea atreh dishmuel hi, uvinhardea la mevatteli kala! ella dei karu lintina "ketiva".
Vechi karu lintina "ketiva" – lichtiva gufa mi la karu la "ketiva"?!
In; dei miggalleya milleta dekaru lintina ketiva, dilma "natan" kaamri.
Tetze?! vehaamar rav ashe: kol kala devatar nissuin – la chayyshinan leh!
May "tetze" name – tetze mishsheni.
Im ken, atta motzi laaz al banav shel rishon! kevan demishsheni hu demappekinan la umerishon la mappekinan la, ate lememar: samuch lemita gershah.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan, mishshum rabbi yehuda bar ilay: bo uree shello kedorot harishonim dorot haacharonim.
Dorot harishonim – bet shammay. dorot haacharonim – rabbi dosa. detanya: shevuyay – ochelet bitruma, divre rabbi dosa.
Amar rabbi dosa: vechi ma asa lah arvi ze? mippene shemmiech lah ben daddeha, pesalah min hakkehunna?!

Veamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan, mishshum rabbi yehuda bar ilay: bo uree shello kedorot harishonim dorot haacharonim. dorot harishonim, machnisin perotehen derech teraksemon, kede lechayyeyvan bemaaser. dorot haacharonim, machnisin perotehen derech gaggot vederech karpefot, kede lefotran min hammaaser.
Deamar rabbi yannay: en hattevel mitchayyev bemaaser, ad sheyyire pene habbayit – shenneemar: "biarti hakkodesh min habbayit".
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu chatzer kovaat, shenneemar: "veachlu visharecha vesaveu".
Mishna hamegaresh et ishto velana immo befunedki, bet shammay omrim: enah tzericha hemennu get sheni; uvet hillel omrim: tzericha hemennu get sheni.
Ematay – bizman shennitgarsha min hannissuin; umodim benitgarsha min haerusin – sheenah tzericha hemennu get sheni, mippene sheen libbo gas bah.
Gemara amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: machloket besherauha shennivala,
b: Devet shammay savri: adam ose beilato beilat zenut;
Uvet hillel savri: en adam ose beilato beilat zenut. aval lo rauha shennivala – divre hakkol enah tzericha hemennu get sheni.
Tenan: umodim benitgarsha min haerusin – sheenah tzericha hemennu get sheni, sheen libbo gas bah. vei besherauha shennivala, ma li min haerusin uma li min hannissuin?

Ella matnitin – beshello rauha shennivala; verabbi yochanan deamar – ki hay tanna, detanya: amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: lo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel al shello rauha shennivala, sheenah tzericha hemennu get sheni,
Al ma nechleku – al sherauha shennivala; shebbet shammay omrim: adam ose beilato beilat zenut; uvet hillel omrim: en adam ose beilato beilat zenut.
Umatnitin – deokemna belo rauha shennivala, bemay peligi? deikka ede yichud, velekka ede via.
Bet shammay savri: la amrinan hen hen ede yichud vehen hen ede via. uvet hillel savri: amrinan hen hen ede yichud vehen hen ede via.
Umodim benitgarsha min haerusin – sheenah tzericha hemennu get sheni, dechevan deen libbo gas bah. la amrinan hen hen ede via.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi?! vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna; veokimna lematnitin beshello rauha shennivala! amorae ninhu veallibba derabbi yochanan.
Mishna kenasah beget kereach – tetze mizze umizze, vechol hadderachim haellu bah.
Get kereach – hakkol mashlimin alav, divre ben nannas. rabbi akiva omer: en mashlimin alav ella kerovim, haruyin lehaid bemakom acher.
Veezehu get kereach? kol shekkesharav merubbin meedav.
Gemara may tama deget kereach? gezera mishshum "kullechem".
Get kereach – hakkol mashlimin alav.
Verabbi akiva, eved may tama la? deatu lememar kasher leedut. karov name, atu lememar kasher leedut!
Ella eved hayeynu tama – dedilma atu leassokeh leyuchasin.
Gazlan – devar yuchasin hu, littachshar! allema tenan, rabbi akiva omer: en mashlimin alav ella kerovim, haruyin lehaid bemakom acher; karov – in, gazlan – la!
Ella eved hayeynu tama – deatu lememar: shachrore shachrereh; gazlan name – atu lememar: teshuva avad; karov – may ikka lememar? karov kulle alma yadi dekarov hu.

Amar rabbi zera amar rabba bar sheelta amar rav hamenuna sava amar rav adda bar ahava: get kereach – kesharav shiva veedav shishsha; shishsha veedav chamishsha; chamishsha veedav arbaa; arbaa veedav shelosha – ad kan machloket ben nannas verabbi akiva. aval kesharav shelosha veedav shenayim – divre hakkol en mashlimin alav ella karov.
Amar leh rabbi zera lerabba bar sheelta: mikkede kol shelosha bimkushshar – kishnayim befashut dame; ma hatam – karov la, af hacha name – karov la!
Amar leh: af ledidi kashya li, usheelteh lerav hamenuna, verav hamenuna lerav adda bar ahava, vaamar leh: hannach lishlosha bimkushshar, delav deorayyta.
Tanya name hachi: get kereach – kesharav shiva veedav shishsha; shishsha veedav chamishsha; chamishsha veedav arbaa; arbaa veedav shelosha – ad kan machloket ben nannas verabbi akiva.
Hishlim alav eved, ben nannas omer: havvalad kasher; verabbi akiva omer: havvalad mamzer. aval kesharav shelosha veedav shenayim – divre hakkol en mashlimin alav ella karov.
Rav yosef matni: "kasher". vehatanya: karov! amar rav pappa, teni: kasher.
Amar rabbi yochanan: lo hucheshru bo ella ed echad karov bilvad, aval tere la – dilma ate lekayyome bitre kerovim vechad kasher.
Amar rav ashe: matnita name dayka –

a: Deka medalleg vetane chad chad; shema minna.
Amar abbaye: shema minna, hay karov chatem i bae – ben battechilla, ben baemtza, ben bassof.
Mimmay – middela keva leh makom. ushema minna: mikkol telata mekayyeyminan, vela baenan retzufin.
Dei salka datach baenan retzufin, likba leh makom lehay karov – battechilla o baemtza o bassof; velachshar beh tuva.
Ki atu lekammeh derabbi amme, amar leh: tze vehashelem alav eved min hashshuk.
Hadaran alach hazzorek

Hamegaresh et ishto, veamar lah: "hare at mutteret lechol adam, ella lifloni". rabbi eliezer mattir, vachachamim osrim. ketzad yaase? yittelennu hemenna veyachazor veyittenennu lah, veyomar lah: "hare at mutteret lechol adam". ketavo betocho, af al pi shechazar umechako – pasul.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: hay "ella" – "chutz" hu, o "al menat" hu?
"Chutz" hu – uvechutz" hu difligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer, deha shayyayr la beget; aval beal menat" – modu leh, midde dehave akkol tenae dealma;
O dilma "al menat" hu – uveal menat" hu diflig rabbi eliezer adderabbanan; aval bechutz" mode – deha shayyayr la beget.

Amar ravina, ta shema: kol habbattim mittammein bingaim, ella shel goyim. i amrat bishlama "chutz" hu – shappir; ella i amrat "al menat" hu – al menat dela mittammu batte goyim hu demittammu batte yisrael, ha mittammu batte goyim – la mittammei batte yisrael?!

Veod, batte goyim mi mittammei?! vehatanya: "venatatti nega tzaraat bevet eretz achuzzatchem" – eretz achuzzatchem mittammea bingaim, veen batte goyim mittammein bingaim! ella shema minna "chutz" hu; shema minna.

Matnitin dela ki hay tanna – detanya, amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda: lo nechleku rabbi eliezer vachachamim al hamegaresh et ishto, veamar lah: "hare at mutteret lechol adam, chutz mippeloni" – sheenah megoreshet. al ma nechleku? al hamegaresh ishto, veamar lah: "hare at mutteret lechol adam, al menat shello tinnasi lifloni" –
b: Sherabbi eliezer mattir lechol adam chutz meoto haish, vachachamim osrim.
May tama derabbi eliezer? midde dehave akkol tenae dealma. verabbanan – kol tenae dealma la shayyayr leh beget, hacha shayyayr la beget.
Umatnitin – deokemna bechutz", may tama derabbi eliezer?

Amar rabbi yannay mishshum zaken echad, amar kera: "veyatza mibbeto vehalcha vehayta leish acher" – afillu lo hittirah ella leish acher, hare zo megoreshet. verabbanan amri, tama derabbi eliezer: hay "ish" – lechol ish vaish.
Verabbi yochanan amar, tama derabbi eliezer mehacha: "veishsha gerusha meishah lo yikkachu" – afillu lo nitgarsha ella meishah, nifsela min hakkehunna – alma have gitta.
Verabbanan – issur kehunna shane.
Bae rabbi abba: bekiddushin heach? tibbee lerabbi eliezer, tibbee lerabbanan.
Tibbee lerabbi eliezer – ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hacha, ella mishshum dichtivi kerae; aval hatam – kinyan mealleya baenan. o dilma, "veyatza"–"vehayta".
Tibbee lerabbanan – ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hacha, ella devaenan keritut – velekka; aval hatam – kinyan kol dehu. o dilma, "veyatza"–"vehayta".
Levatar deibbaya leh, hadar pashta – ben lerabbi eliezer ben lerabbanan, baenan "veyatza"–"vehayta".
Amar abbaye: im timtza lomar ita lidrabbi abba;
Ba reuven vekiddeshah chutz mishshimon, uva shimon vekiddeshah chutz meruven, umetu shenehem – mityabbemet lelevi, veen ani kore bah "eshet shene metim".
May tama? kiddushe diruven ahano, kiddushe deshimon la ahano.

Veella eshet shene metim – hechi mashkachat la? kegon shebba reuven vekiddeshah chutz mishshimon, uva shimon vekiddeshah setam – dekiddushe reuven ahano lemesra aalma, vekiddushe deshimon ahano lemesra aruven.
Bae abbaye, amar lah: "hare at mutteret lechol adam, chutz meruven veshimon", vechazar veamar lah: "liruven veshimon", mahu?
Mi amrinan: may daasar shera; o dilma – may daasar shera, umay dishra asar? im timtza lomar

a: May daasar shera; "liruven", mahu? liruven – vehu haddin leshimon, vehay dekaamar liruven – mishshum diftach beh; o dilma – liruven davka?
Veim timtza lomar "liruven" davka; "leshimon", mahu? leshimon – vehu haddin liruven, vehay dekaamar "shimon" – mishshum dislek minneh; o dilma – leshimon davka?
Bae rav ashe: "af leshimon", mahu? "af" – aruven kae; o dilma, "af" – aalma kae? teku.
Tanu rabbanan: leachar petirato shel rabbi eliezer, nichnesu arbaa zekenim lehashiv al devarav, ellu hen: rabbi yose haggelili, verabbi tarfon, verabbi elazar ben azarya, verabbi akiva.
Naana rabbi tarfon veamar: hare shehalcha zo, venisset leachiv shel ze shenneesra alav, umet belo banim – lo nimtza ze oker davar min hattora? ha lamadta, sheen ze keritut.
Naana rabbi yose haggelili veamar: hechan matzinu asur laze umuttar laze? haasur – asur lakkol, vehammuttar – muttar lakkol! ha lamadta, sheen ze keritut.
Naana rabbi elazar ben azarya veamar: "keritut" – davar hakkoret beno levenah. ha lamadta, sheen ze keritut.

Naana rabbi akiva veamar: hare shehalcha zo venisset leechad min hashshuk vehayu lah banim, venitarmela o nitgarsha, veavra venisset laze shenneesra alav – lo nimtza get batel, uvaneha mamzerim? ha lamadta, sheen ze keritut.
Davar acher: hare shehaya ze shenneesra alav kohen, umet hamegaresh – lo nimtzet almana etzlo, ugerusha etzel kol adam?
Vekal vachomer: ma gerusha – shehi kalla, asura bishvil tzad gerushin shebbah; eshet ish – shehi chamura. lo kol shekken?! ha lamadta, sheen ze keritut.
Amar lahen rabbi yehoshua: en meshivin et haari leachar mita.
Amar rava: kullehu it lehu pircha, levar midderabbi elazar ben azarya – delet leh pircha. tanya name hachi, amar rabbi yose: roe ani et divre rabbi elazar ben azarya middivre kullan.

Amar mar, naana rabbi tarfon veamar: hare shehalcha zo venisset leachiv shel ze shenneesra alav, umet belo banim – lo nimtza ze oker davar min hattora? oker?! ihu akar?! ella "matne laakor davar min hattora".
Matne?! mi kaamar la: la saggi la dela minnasva leh laachu dehahu gavra?! ella "gorem laakor davar min hattora".
Gorem?! ella meatta, bat achiv lo yissa – shemma yamut belo banim, venimtza gorem laakor davar min hattora! hayeynu pircha.
Uvemay? ilema bechutz", mishra share rabbi eliezer!

Detanya: mode rabbi eliezer bimgaresh et ishto, veamar lah: "hare at mutteret lechol adam, chutz mippeloni", vehalcha venisset leechad min hashshuk, venitarmela o nitgarsha, shemmutteret laze shenneesra alav!
Ella beal menat".

Naana rabbi yose haggelili veamar: hechan matzinu asur laze umuttar laze? haasur – asur lakkol, vehammuttar – muttar lakkol. vela?! vahare teruma vekadashim, sheasura laze, umutteret laze! beissur ishsha ka amrinan.
Vahare arayot! beishut kaamrinan.
Hare eshet ish! hayeynu pircha.
Uvemay? illema beal menat" – hare huttera etzlo biznut! ella bechutz".
Naana rabbi akiva veamar: hare shehalcha zo venisset leechad min hashshuk vehayu lah banim, venitarmela o nitgarsha, veamda venisset laze shenneesra alav, lo nimtza get batel uvaneha mamzerin?
I hachi – bechullehu tenae dealma name la tinnesiv, dilma la mekayyeyma leh litnaeh venimtza get batel uvaneha mamzerin! hayeynu pircha.
Uvemay? ilema bechutz", mishra share rabbi eliezer!

Detanya: mode haya rabbi eliezer bimgaresh et ishto, veamar lah: "hare at mutteret lechol adam, chutz mippeloni", vehalcha venisset leechad min hashshuk venitarmela o nitgarsha, shemmutteret laze shenneesra alav! ella beal menat".

Davar acher: hare shehaya ze shenneesra alav kohen, umet hamegaresh, lo nimtzet almana etzlo, ugerusha etzel kol adam? vekal vachomer: uma gerusha shehi kalla – asura mishshum tzad gerushin shebbah, eshet ish chamura – lo kol shekken?!
Uvemay? illema beal menat",
b: Hare gerusha etzlo – biznut! ella bechutz".
Verabbi akiva, i "chutz" sevira leh – lotev "chutz", vei "al menat" sevira leh – lotev "al menat"!
Rabbi akiva shemia leh deikka deamar "chutz" veikka deamar "al menat"; man deamar "chutz" – hay pircha, uman deamar "al menat" – hay pircha.
Umay pircha? i nema issur kehunna shane, ha rabbi eliezer name meissur kehunna ka mayyte leh!
Rava – kerabbi yannay mishshum zaken echad ka matne.
Amar lahen rabbi yehoshua: en meshivin et haari leachar mita. lememra derabbi yehoshua kevoteh sevira leh?! veha ihu name mifrach kafarech!
Hachi kaamar lehu: ledidi name it li pircha; mihu ben ledidi, ben ledidchu – en meshivin et haari leachar mita.

Umay pircha derabbi yehoshua? detanya, amar rabbi yehoshua: makkish kodme havaya sheniyya, lekodme havaya rishona; ma kodme havaya rishona – dela agida beinish acharina; af kodme havaya sheniyya – dela agida beinish acharina.

Gufa – mode rabbi eliezer bimgaresh ishto veamar lah: "hare at mutteret lechol adam chutz mippeloni", vehalcha venisset leechad min hashshuk, venitarmela o nitgarsha, shemmutteret laze shenneesra alav.
Heshiv rabbi shimon bar elazar teshuva ledivre rabbi eliezer: hechan matzinu shezze oser veze mattir?
Vela?! vahare yevama – devaal oser, veyavam mattir!
Hatam, yavam hu ka asar la, dei mibbaal – ha sharya vekayyma.
Hare nedarim, denoder oser vechacham mattir! ha amar rabbi yochanan: en chacham mattir kelum ella bacharata.
Hare hafarat habbaal, deishsha noderet uvaal mefer! hatam kidrav pinchas mishshemeh derava – deamar rav pinchas mishshemeh derava: kol hannoderet – al daat balah hi noderet.
Naana rabbi elazar ben azarya veamar: "keritut" – davar hakkoret beno levenah; ha lamadta, sheen ze keritut.

Verabbanan, hay "keritut" may avdi leh? mibbee lehu lechidtanya: "hare ze gittich al menat shello tishti yayin; al menat shello telchi levet avich"; "leolam" – en ze keritut. "sheloshim yom" – hare ze keritut.
Veiddach – mikkaret–keritut" nafka. veiddach – "karet–keritut" la darshi.
Amar rava: "hare ze gittich, al menat shello tishti yayin"; "kol yeme chayyay" – en ze keritut. "kol yeme chayye peloni" – hare ze keritut.
May shena chayye feloni – dedilma maet umekayyeyma leh litnaeh; chayye dideh name – dilma maet, umekayyeyma leh litnaeh!
Ella ema: "kol yeme chayyechi" – en ze keritut, "kol yeme chayyay" o "chayye feloni" – hare ze keritut.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: "hayyom i at ishti, ulemachar at ishti", mahu? tibbee lerabbi eliezer, tibbee lerabbanan.
Tibbee lerabbi eliezer – ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam, ella dilman deka share – ka share leolam; aval hacha – la. o dilma la shena.
Tibbee lerabbanan – ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam, ella dela paska minneh ligmare; aval hacha, kevan defaska – paska.
Batar devaya, hadar pashta:

a: Mistabbera, ben lerabbi eliezer ben lerabbanan, kevan defaska – paska.
Tanu rabbanan: "hare ze gittich al menat shettinnasi lifloni" – hare zo lo tinnase, veim nisset – lo tetze.
May kaamar? amar rav nachman, hachi kaamar: hare zo lo tinnase lo, shemma yomru neshehen notnin bemattana. veim nisset leacher – lo tetze.
Umishshum gezera – la mappekinan minneh, vesharenan eshet ish lealma?!
Ella amar rav nachman, hachi kaamar: hare zo lo tinnase lo, shemma yomru neshehem notnin bemattana. veim nisset lo – lo tetze, demishshum gezera la mappekinan.
Amar leh rava: lo – hu delo tinnase, ha leacher – tinnase?! veha baaya kayyomeh litnaa!

Vechi tema: efshar deminnasva hayyom umiggarsha limchar – umekayyeyma litnaa; ulehach difligat aleh derav yehuda kamdammet leh – deittemar: "kuvnnam enay beshena hayyom, im ishan lemachar", amar rav yehuda: al yishan hayyom, shemma yishan lemachar;
Verav nachman amar: yishan hayyom, veen choshshin shemma yishan lemachar;
Hachi hasheta?! hatam bedideh kayyma, dei bae – mevarez nafsheh besilvata, vela naem; hacha – bedida kayyma leiggaroshe?!
Ella amar rava: hare zo lo tinnase lo lo, velo leacher. lo lo tinnase – shemma yomru: neshotehem notnin bemattana; leacher lo tinnase – devaaya kayyomeh litnaa.
Veim nisset lo lo tetze – demishshum gezera la mappekinan; leacher tetze – devaaya lekayyomeh litnaa.
Tanya kevoteh derava: hare zo lo tinnase lo lo velo leacher, veim nisset lo – lo tetze, leacher – tetze.

Tanu rabbanan: "hare ze gittich al menat shettaali larakia"; "al menat shetterdi lattehom"; "al menat shettivlei kane shel arba ammot"; "al menat shettavii li kane ben mea amma"; "al menat shettaavri et hayyam haggadol beraglayich" – eno get.
Rabbi yehuda ben tema omer: kaze – get. kelal amar rabbi yehuda ben tema: kol tenay shei efshar lo lekayyeymo besofo, vehitna alav mittechillato – eno ella kemafligah bidvarim, vechasher.

Amar rav nachman amar rav: halacha kerabbi yehuda ben tema. amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: matnitin name dayka, dekatane: kol sheefshar lo lekayyeymo besofo, vehitna alav bitchillato – tenao kayyaym; ha i efshar – tenao batel; shema minna.
Ibbaya lehu: "hare ze gittich al menat shettochli besar chazir", mahu? amar abbaye: hi hi. rava amar: efshar deachla velakya.
Leabbaye, "kelal" – leetoye besar chazir. lerava, "kaze" – lemaote besar chazir.
Metivi: "hare ze gittich al menat shettibbaali lifloni", nitkayyem hattenay – hare ze get, veim lav – eno get. "al menat shello tibbaali leabba, uleavich" – en choshshin shemma nivala lahen.
Veillu "al menat shettibbaali leabba uleavich" – la katane; leabbaye nicha, lerava kashya!

Amar lach rava: bishlama besar chazir – efshar deachla velakya; peloni name – efshar dimshachada leh bemamona; ella abba veavich – bedida kayyma?! nehi deihi avda issura, abba veavich mi avdi issura?!
Lerava, "kelal" – leetoye abba veavich; "kaze" – lemaote besar chazir.
b: Leabbaye, "kelal" – leetoye besar chazir; "kaze" – lemaote peloni.

Metivi: "hare ze gittich al menat shettochli besar chazir"; veim hayta zara – "al menat shettochli bitruma"; veim hayta nezira – "al menat shettishti yayin"; nitkayyem hattenay – hare ze get; veim lav – eno get. lerava nicha, leabbaye kashya!
Amar lach abbaye: mi savrat divre hakkol hi?! ha manni – rabbanan hi.
Vetippok leh dematne al ma shekkatuv battora hu, vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora – tenao batel!
Amar rav adda bereh derav ika: ki amrinan matne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel – kegon sheerah kesutah veonatah, dehu ka akar; aval hacha – ihi ka akra.
Matkef la ravina: kelum ka akra ihi – ella lekayyome litnay dideh; ishtechach deihu ka akar!
Ella amar ravina: ki amrinan matne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel – kegon sheerah kesutah veonatah, devadday ka akar; aval hacha – mi kaamar la: la saggi dela achla?! la techol, vela tiggarash.
Ketzad yaase – yittelennu hemenna vechulei: man tanna? amar chizkiyya: rabbi shimon ben elazar hi.
Detanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: ad sheyyittelennu hemenna, veyachazor veyittenennu lah, veyomar lah: "he gittich".
Rabbi yochanan amar: afillu tema rabbi – dilchon amar: shane hacha, hoil vekinato lippasel bo lakkehunna.
Ketavo betocho: amar rav safra: "ketavo betocho" tenan.
Peshita, "ketavo betocho" tenan! mahu detema hane mille leachar hattoref, aval lifne hattoref – afillu al pe name pasul, ka mashma lan.
Verava amar: lo shanu ella leachar hattoref, aval lifne hattoref – afillu al pe name pasul.
Veazda rava letameh – daamar lehu rava lehanhu dechatvi gitte: shattiku shattoke levaal, ad dechatvitu leh letoref degitta.

Tanu rabbanan: kol hattenain poslin bagget, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: kol shepposel al pe posel bichtav, vechol sheeno posel al pe eno posel bichtav – "chutz", shepposel al pe, posel bichtav; "al menat", sheeno posel al pe, eno posel bichtav.
Amar rabbi zera: machloket lifne hattoref – derabbi savar: gazrinan "al menat" attu "chutz"; verabbanan savri: la gazrinan "al menat" attu "chutz". aval leachar hattoref –

a: Divre hakkol kasher. umatnitin, dekatane "ketavo" veokimna bechutz"; aval "al menat" la pasel – ibbaet ema: lifne hattoref, verabbanan; veibbaet ema: leachar hattoref, vedivre hakkol.
Verava amar: machloket leachar hattoref – derabbi savar: gazrinan attu lifne hattoref; verabbanan savri: la gazrinan attu lifne hattoref. aval lifne hattoref – divre hakkol pasul.
Umatnitin, dekatane "ketavo" veokimna bechutz"; aval "al menat" la pasel – achar hattoref, verabbanan hi.
Tane avu derabbi avin kammeh derabbi zera: katav get al tenay – divre hakkol pasul. divre hakkol pasul?! veha miflag peligi!
Ella ema: ledivre hakkol kasher, vehechi dame – leachar hattoref.
Velema: hare ze pasul – verabbi! tanna "divre hakkol" atneyeh; "kasher" befasul" michallaf leh, "hare ze" bedivre hakkol" la michallaf leh.
Mishna "hare at mutteret lechol adam – ella leabba"; uleavich"; "leachi"; uleachich"; leeved; ulenochri; ulechol mi sheen lah alav kiddushin – kasher.

"Hare at mutteret lechol adam" – ella almana lechohen gadol; gerusha vachalutza lechohen hedyot; mamzeret unetina leyisrael; bat yisrael lemamzer ulenatin; vechol mi sheyyesh lah alav kiddushin, afillu baavera – pasul.
Gemara kelala deresha – leetoye shear chayyayve charetot. kelala desefa – leetoye shear chayyayve lavin, kegon ammoni umoavi (netini, mitzri vaadomi).
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: chutz mikkiddushe katan, mahu? mi amrinan hasheta miha lav bar havaya hu, o dilma ate lichlal havaya?
Amar leh, tenetuha: ketanna mitgareshet bekiddushe aviha.
Ammay? veha baenan: "veyatza"–"vehayta"? ella atya lichlal havaya; hacha name – atya lichlal havaya.
"Chutz min hannoladim", mahu? hasheta miha la ityelid[u], o dilma atidi demityayldi?
Amar leh: tenetuha: "leeved ulenochri", im ita – eved venochri name avidi demiggayyeyri!
Hanach – lav leiggayyore kayymi, hane – leityelode kayymi.
Chutz mibbaal achotah, mahu? hasheta miha la chazya leh, o dilma zimnin demeta achotah vechazya leh?
Amar leh: tenetuha: "leeved ulenochri", eved venochri name avidi demiggayyeyri! gerut la shechicha, mita shechicha.
"Chutz mizzenutich", mahu? benissuin – ha la shayyayr, o dilma shayyayr – bevia?
Amar leh, tenetuha: "leabba uleavicha". uvemay? ilema benissuin, abba veavich bene nissuin ninhu?! ella lav biznut – uleabba uleavich hu dela shayyayr, ha leacher – shayyayr.
Dilma benissuin, daavar veinnesiv.
Chutz mishshello kedarkah, mahu? bichdarkah ha la shayyayr, o dilma "mishkeve ishsha" ketiv?
"Chutz mehafarat nedarayich", mahu? benissuin ha lo shayyayr, o dilma "ishah yekimennu veishah yeferennu" ketiv?
"Chutz mitterumatich", mahu? benissuin ha la shayyayr, o dilma "kinyan kaspo" ketiv?
"Chutz miyyerushshatich", mahu? benissuin ha la shayyayr, o dilma "lishero", "veyarash otah", ketiv?
"Chutz mikkiddushayich bishtar", mahu? mi amrinan: efshar dimkaddesh la bechesef uvevia; o dilma "veyatza"–"vehayta", ittakkush havoyot lahadade?
Teku.
Mishna gufo shel get: "hare at mutteret lechol adam".
b: Rabbi yehuda omer: "veden, deyeheve lichi minnay – sefer teruchin, veiggeret shibbukin, veget pitturin; limhach lehitnesava lechol gevar dititzbiyyin". gufo shel get shichrur: "hare at (bat) [ben] chorin"; "hare at leatzmach".
Gemara peshita, amar lah leishto: "hare at bat chorin" – lo amar velo kelum; amar lah leshifchato: "hare at mutteret lechol adam" – lo amar velo kelum.
Amar lah leishsha: "hare at leatzmach", mahu? ligmare kaamar la, o limlacha kaamar la?

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: ta shema, ditnan: gufo shel get shichrur: "hare at (bat) [ben] chorin"; "hare at leatzmach". uma avda, dikni leh gufeh, ki amar leh: "hare at leatzmach" – keni gufeh; ishsha, dela keni gufa – lo kol shekken?!
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: amar lo leavdo: "en li esek bach", mahu?

Amar leh rav chanin lerav ashe, veamri la rav chanin machoznaa lerav ashe: ta shema, detanya: hammocher avdo legoy – yatza lecherut, vetzarich get shichrur merabbo rishon. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim – shello katav alav ono, aval katav alav ono – zehu shichruro.
May "ono"? amar rav sheshet, dichtav leh: "lichshettivrach mimmennu, en li esek bach".

Rabbi yehuda omer: "veden, deyeheve lichi minnay – sefer teruchin veiggeret shibbukin". bemay kamippalgi? rabbanan savri: yadayim sheen mochichot havyayn yadayim, veaf al gav dela ketav lah "veden" – mochcha milleta divhay gitta ka megaresh la.

Verabbi yehuda savar: yadayim sheen mochichot la havyayn yadayim, vetama dichtav la "veden" – demochcha milleta divhay gitta ka megaresh la; aval la ketav lah "veden" – amri: bedibbura garsha, ushetara reaya bealma hu.
Amar abbaye: hay man dechatev gitta, la lichtov "veden" – demashma vedin; ella "veden".
Vela lichtov "iggeret" – demashma (iggeret) [iggara]; ella "iggeret". vela lichtov "limhach" – demashma li mehach; vela lichtov "limchach" – demashma ki chucha.
"Ditihviyin", "dititzbiyin" – telata telata yodin; demashma tehevyayn vetitzbeyayn. velorcheh levav "deteruchin", ulevav "deshibbukin"; demashma terichin ushevikin.
Velorcheh levav "dechaddu"; demashma "uchedi". vela lichtov "leitnesava" – demashma la yitnasva, ella "lehitnesava".
Ibbaya lehu: baenan "veden", o la baenan "veden"?
Ta shema, deatken rava begitte: "ech pelanya bar pelanya, petar vetarech yat pelonita inteteh, dahavat inteteh min kodam dena – miyyoma denan ulealam". veillu "veden" la kaamar.
Uletamaych, kullehu mi kaamar? ella baenan, hacha name baenan;
"Miyyoma denan" – leappoke midderabbi yose, deamar: zemanno shel shetar mochiach alav;
"Ulealam" –

a: Leappoke middiva minneh rava merav nachman – deamar: "hayyom i at ishti ulemachar at ishti".

Gufo shel get shichrur: "hare at (bat) [ben] chorin"; "hare at leatzmach": atken rav yehuda bishtar zevine deavde: "avda denan mutzedak leavdu; ufetir vaatir min charure, umin alule, umin arore malka umalketa; ureshum deinish la it alohi, umenukke mikkol mum, umin shechin denafek ad tatzhar chadat veattik".
May asuteh? amar abbaye: ginbera, umartecha, vechavrita, vechalla dechamra, umishcha dezeta, venatpik chivvara; veshayyfi leh begadpa daavoza.
Mishna shelosha gittin pesulin, veim nisset hauolad kasher –
Katav bichtav yado, veen alav edim; yesh alav edim, veen bo zeman; yesh bo zeman, veen bo ella ed echad; hare ellu shelosha gittin pesulin, veim nisset – havvalad kasher.
Rabbi eliezer omer: af al pi sheen alav edim, ella shennetano lah bifne edim – kasher, vegova minnechasim meshuebadim; sheen haedim chotmim al hagget ella mippene tikkun haolam.
Gemara vetu lekka?! veha ikka get yashan! hatam lo tetze, hacha tetze.
Hanicha leman deamar: hacha tetze, ella leman deamar: hacha lo tetze, may ikka lememar?
Hatam tinnase lechattechilla, hacha diavad.
Veha ikka get kereach! hatam hauolad mamzer, hacha havvalad kasher.
Hanicha lerabbi meir (deamar: kol hameshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim begittin, havvalad mamzer). ella lerabbanan, may ikka lememar?
Hatam tetze, hacha lo tetze.
Hanicha leman deamar hacha lo tetze, ella leman deamar hacha tetze, may ikka lememar? bimkushshar la ka mayyre.
Veha ikka shelom malchut! hatam tetze, hacha lo tetze.
Hanicha leman deamar hacha lo tetze, ella leman deamar tetze, may ikka lememar? (hatam havvalad mamzer, hacha havvalad kasher.
Hanicha lerabbi meir, ella lerabbanan may ikka lememar?) mokem la kidrabbi meir; vehatam havvalad mamzer, hacha havvalad kasher.
Minyana deresha lemaote may, uminyana desefa lemaote may?
Minyana deresha – lemaote hane daamaran.
Minyana desefa – lemaote ha detanya: hammevi get mimmedinat hayyam, netano lah velo amar lah: "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam" – yotzi vehavvalad mamzer, divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: en havvalad mamzer. ketzad yaase? yittelennu hemenna, veyachazor veyittenennu lah bifne shenayim, veyomar: "befanay nichtav uvefanay nechtam".
Katav bichtav yado veen alav edim. amar rav: "ketav yado" shaninu.
Aheyay? illema aresha – peshita! "ketav yado" katane!
Veella ammetziata – hare yesh alav edim! ella assefa: yesh bo zeman veen bo ella ed echad –
b: Vedavka ketav yado veed; aval ketav sofer veed – lo.
Ushemuel amar: afillu ketav sofer veed, shehare shaninu: katav sofer veed – kasher.
Verav – mi dame?! hatam tinnase lechattechilla, hacha diavad.
Ushemuel – la kashya; ha besafra demuvehak, veha besafra dela muvehak.
Vechen amar rabbi yochanan: "ketav yado" shaninu. amar leh rabbi elazar: hare yesh alav edim! amar leh: assefa.
Zimnin amar rav: tetze, zimnin amar rav: lo tetze.
Ha ketzad? yesh lah banim – lo tetze, en lah banim – tetze.
Metiv mar zutera bar toviyya: vechullan, shehayu bahen sefek kiddushin o sefek gerushin – hare ellu choltzot velo mityabbemot.
Ketzad sefek kiddushin? zarak lah kiddushin – safek karov lah, safek karov lo, zehu sefek kiddushin.
Sefek gerushin – katav bichtav yado veen alav edim, yesh alav edim veen bo zeman, yesh bo zeman veen bo ella ed echad – hare ze sefek gerushin.
Vei amrat lo tetze, tzaratah atya leyabbome!
Tityabbem, veen bechach kelum; chashasha derabbanan hi.
Levi amar: leolam lo tetze. vechen amar rabbi yochanan: leolam lo tetze.
Vechen amar lehu rabbi yochanan livne rabbi chalafta demin huna, hachi amar avuchon: leolam lo tetze; vekartzit shebbeamir enah poselet beme chattat.
May kartzit? amar abbaye: didbeta devene chefe.
Metiv rav daniel bar rav kattina: kol haofot poslin beme chattat, chutz min hayyona – mippene shemmotzetzet. veim ita, nitne: chutz miyyona vekartzit!
La pesika leh, digdola la pasla, uketanna pasla. vead kamma? amar rabbi yirmeya, veittema rabbi amme: ad kezayit.
Rabbi elazar omer: af al pi vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar rav: halacha kerabbi elazar begittin. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar: af bishtarot.
Verav savar – bishtarot la?! ha katane: vegova minnechasim meshuebadim!
Rabbi elazar tarte amar; verav savar kevoteh bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.
Vechen amar rabbi yaakov bar idde amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha kerabbi elazar begittin. verabbi yannay amar: afillu reach hagget en bo.
Verabbi yannay let leh derabbi elazar?! hachi kaamar: lerabbanan – afillu reach hagget en bo.
Vechen amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar resh lakish: halacha kerabbi elazar begittin, verabbi yochanan amar: afillu reach hagget en bo.
Lema rabbi yochanan let leh derabbi elazar?! hachi kaamar: lerabbanan – afillu reach hagget en bo.
Shelach leh rabbi abba bar zavda lemari bar mar, bei minneh merav huna: halacha kerabbi elazar begittin, o en halacha?

Addehachi nach nafsheh derav huna. amar leh rabba bereh, hachi amar abba mishshemeh derava: halacha kerabbi elazar begittin. verabbotenu habbekiin bidvar halacha, mishshum rabbenu amru: halacha kerabbi elazar begittin – deamar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: halacha kerabbi elazar begittin.

Ikka deamri: vachaverenu habbekiin bidvar halacha, vetalmide rabbenu, mishshum rabbenu amru: halacha kerabbi elazar begittin – deamar rav chisda amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: halacha kerabbi elazar begittin.
Vechen ki ata ravin, amar rabbi elazar amar rav: halacha kerabbi elazar begittin.
Mishna shenayim sheshshalchu shene gittin shavin, venitarvu; noten shenehem lazo, ushenehem lazo. lefichach, avad echad mehen – hare hashsheni batel.
Chamishsha shekkatvu kelal betoch hagget – "ish peloni megaresh pelonit, ufeloni pelonit", vehaedim millematta; kullan kesherin, veyinnaten lechol achat veachat.
Haya kotev tofes lechol echad veechad, vehaedim millematta; et shehaedim nikrin immo – kasher.
Gemara man tanna? amar rabbi yirmeya: dela kerabbi elazar. dei rabbi elazar, kevan deamar ede mesira karti – ha la yadi behe minnayyhu ka miggarsha.
Abbaye amar: afillu tema rabbi elazar – ema devae rabbi elazar ketiva lishmah, netina lishmah mi bae?!
Chamishsha shekkatvu kelal kulei. hechi dame kelal, hechi dame tofes?
Amar rabbi yochanan: zeman echad lechullan – zehu kelal. zeman lechol echad veechad – zehu tofes.
Veresh lakish amar:

a: Afillu zeman echad lechullan name have tofes, ella hechi dame kelal? dechatev "anu peloni ufeloni gerashnu neshotenu pelonit ufelonit".

Matkef la rabbi abba: lerabbi yochanan deamar zeman echad lechullan – zehu kelal, lechush dilma ki (chatmu) [chatimi] sahadi, abbatra hu dachatimi! mi la tanya: edim chatumin al sheelat shalom beget – pasul, chayyshinan shemma al sheelat shalom chatmu?!
Lav ittemar ala: amar rabbi avahu, ledidi mipparsha li minneh derabbi yochanan: "shaalu" – pasul, "veshaalu" – kasher; hacha name – dichtiv beh: "peloni ufeloni ufeloni".
Vetu, lerabbi yochanan deamar zeman lechol echad – zehu tofes; may irya mishshum tofes? vetippok leh dehave leh nichtav bayyom venechtam ballayla!
Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe, hachi amrinan mishshemeh derabbi yochanan: dichtiv behu "bechad beshabba, bechad beshabba".

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe, leresh lakish deamar: zeman echad lechullan name tofes have; vehechi dame kelal – dichtiv beh hachi: "anu peloni ufeloni gerashnu neshotenu pelonit ufelonit"; nimtzeu shete nashim mitgarshot beget echad, vehattora amra: "vechatav lah" – velo lah velachavertah!
Dahadar ketav: "peloni gerash pelonit, ufeloni gerash pelonit".
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe, umay shena meha detanya: hakkotev kol nechasav lishne avadav – kanu, umeshachrerin ze et ze?
Velav okemna bishne shetarot?!
Tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan, tanya kevoteh deresh lakish.

Tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: chamishsha shekkatvu betoch hagget: "ish peloni megaresh pelonit, ufeloni pelonit, ufeloni pelonit", uzeman echad lechullan, vehaedim millematta – kullan kesherim, vetinnaten lechol achat veachat.
Zeman lechol echad veechad vehaedim millematta – et shehaedim nikraim immo, kasher. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: im yesh revach benehen – pasul, veim lav – kasher; sheen zeman mafsikan.

Tanya kevoteh deresh lakish: chamishsha shekkatvu kelal betoch hagget – "anu peloni ufeloni gerashnu neshotenu pelonit ufelonit, peloni gerash pelonit ufeloni gerash pelonit"; uzeman echad lechullan, vehaedim millematta – kullan kesherin, vetinnaten lechol achat veachat.
Zeman lechol echad veechad, verevach lechol echad veechad, vehaedim millematta – et shehaedim nikrain immo, kasher. rabbi meir omer: af al pi sheen revach benehem – pasul, shehazzeman mafsikan.
Veresh lakish – may irya zeman lechol echad veechad? ha amar: zeman echad lechullan name tofes have!
Hane mille hecha dela arvinhu meikkara; aval hacha, dearvinhu meikkara, i paleg lehu zeman – in, i la – la.
Mishna shene gittin shekketavan ze betzad ze, ushenayim edim ivrim baim mittachat ze letachat ze, ushenayim edim yevanim baim mittachat ze letachat ze – et shehaedim harishonim nikrain immo, kasher.
Ed echad ivri veed echad yevani, veed echad ivri veed echad yevani, bain mittachat ze letachat ze – shenehem pesulin.
Gemara velittachshar hay biruven", vehay beven yaakov ed", deha tenan: "ben ish peloni ed" – kasher!
Dichtiv: "reuven ben" akkamma, veyaakov ed" abbatra.
Velittachshar hay biruven ben", velittachshar hay beyaakov ed", deha tenan: "ish peloni ed" – kasher!
Dela ketiv "ed". veibbaet ema: leolam dichtiv "ed", udeyadinan beha chatima delav deyaakov hu.
b: Vedilma bishma daavu chatem! la shavek inish shemeh vechatem shema daavu.
Vedilma simana shavveyeh – deha rav tzayer kevora, rabbi chanina – charuta, rav chisda – samech, rav hoshaya – ayin, rabba bar rav huna tzayer machuta!
La chatzif inish leshauoye lishma daavu simana.
Velittachshar hay bishne edim ivrim, velittachshar hay bishne edim yevanim – ditnan: get shekketavo ivrit veedav yevanit, yevanit veedav ivrit – kasher!
Vechi tema, kevan demufelag bishne shitin – la; vehaamar chizkiyya: milleahu bikrovim – kasher!
Ha tane zeeri: shenehen kesherin. vetanna didan – dilma gunedalit chatuym, vechullehu achad hu dachatimi.
Ed echad ivri veed echad yevani. velittachshar hay beed echad ivri veed echad yevani, vehay beed echad ivri veed echad yevani – deha tenan: ed echad ivri veed echad yevani – kasher!
Ha tane zeeri: shenehem kesherim. vetanna didan – dilma gunedalit chatuym; utelata achad, vechad achad.
Mishna shiyyer miktzat hagget uchetavo bedaf hashsheni, vehaedim millematta – kasher. chatmu edim berosh haddaf, min hatztzad, o meacharav; beget pashut – pasul.

Hikkif rosho shel ze betzad rosho shel ze, vehaedim baemtza – shenehem pesulin. sofo shel ze betzad sofo shel ze, vehaedim baemtza – et shehaedim nikrin immo, kasher. rosho shel ze betzad sofo shel ze, vehaedim baemtza – et shehaedim nikrin besofo, kasher.
Get shekketavo ivrit veedav yevonit; yevonit veedav ivrit; ed echad ivri veed echad yevoni; katav sofer veed – kasher.

"Ish peloni, ed" – kasher. "ben ish peloni, ed" – kasher; "ish peloni ben ish peloni", velo katav "ed" – kasher, vechach hayu nekiyye haddaat shebbirushalayim osin. katav chanichato vachanichatah – kasher.
Gemara velechush dilma hane tere gitte havo; veitremi leh zeman dekamma, veedim devatra; vegazyeh lizman devatra veedim dekamma!
Amar rabbi abba amar rav: kesheyyesh revach millematta. vedilma zeman devatra miggaz gazyeh! kidamar rabbi abba amar rav: kesheyyesh revach millematta;

a: Hacha name – kesheyyesh revach millemala.
Vedilma immeloche immelich (uchetav)!
Dichtiv "hare at" millematta, umutteret" millemala. vedilma itremi leh? kulle hay la chayyshinan.
Rav ashe amar: didia beh metachta dimgilleta.
Chatmu edim berosh haddaf vechulei. ini?! veha rav chatem min hatztzad! hatam besheggaggo kelappe chetav.
Ella ha dekatane: hikkif rosho shel ze betzad rosho shel ze, vehaedim baemtza – shenehem pesulin; velichze he minnayyhu kelappe chetav, velittachshar!
Hatam, dirme leh keivra.
I hachi, sefa dekatane: rosho shel ze betzad sofo shel ze, vehaedim baemtza – et shehaedim nikrin besofo, kasher. vei dirme keivra – lav bahade hay mikkere, velav bahade hay mikkere!
Ella rav bediske hava chatem.
