Get shekketavo ivrit vechulei katav sofer veed kasher. amar rabbi yirmeya: "chatam sofer" shaninu.
Amar rav chisda: ha manni – rabbi yose hi.
Hahi ketubbat chatanim daatay lekammeh derabbi avahu, dahavo yadi leh letufesa, velachatimat yeda dechad sahada. sevar leachshora, amar leh rabbi yirmeya: "chatam sofer" shaninu.
Katav chanichato vachanichatah – kasher. tanu rabbanan: chanichat avot begittin – ad asara dorot. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: shelosha dorot – kasher, mikkan veelach – pasul.
Keman azla ha deamar rabbi chanina: katav chanichat avot begittin ad shelosha dorot? keman – kerabbi shimon ben elazar.
Amar rav huna: may keraa? "ki tolid banim uvene vanim venoshantem".

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: lo charva eretz yisrael ad sheavdu bah shiva batte dinim avoda zara, veellu hen: yarovam ben nevat, uvasha ben achiyya, veachav ben amri, veyehu ben nimshi, ufekach ben remalyahu, umenachem ben gadi, vehoshea ben ela. shenneemar: "umella yoledet hashshiva, nafcha nafshah, baa shimshah beod yomam, bosha vechafera".
Amar rav amme: may keraa? "ki tolid banim uvene vanim".
Amaru leh rav kahana verav assi lerav, ketiv beh behoshea ben ela: "vayyaas hara beene Adonai, rak lo kemalche yisrael", uchetiv: "alav ala shalmaneser vegomer"?

Amar lehu: otan pardesiot shehoshiv yarovam al hadderachim kede shello yaalu yisrael laregel, ba hoshea uvittelan, veaf al pi chen lo alu yisrael laregel. amar hakkadosh baruch hu: otan shanim shello alu yisrael laregel – yelchu bashshevi.

Amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva, veamri la amar rav chisda amar rabbi yirmeya, daresh marimar: may dichtiv: "vayyishkod Adonai al haraa vayvieha alenu, ki tzaddik Adonai elohenu"? mishshum detzaddik Adonai elohenu" – "vayyishkod Adonai al haraa vayvieha alenu"?!
Ella tzedaka asa hakkadosh baruch hu im yisrael, shehigla galut tzidkiyyahu – vaadayin galut yechanya kayyemet; dichtiv beh begalut yechanya: "hecharash vehammasger elef";
"Charash" – shebbeshaa sheppotchin, naasu hakkol kechershin. "masger" – kevan shessogrin, shuv enan potchin. vechamma – elef.
Ulla amar: shehikdim shete shanim livnoshantem".
b: Amar rav acha bar yaakov: shema minna, "mehera" demare alma – tamne mea vechamshin vetarte hu.
Mishna get meusse, beyisrael – kasher, uvegoyim – pasul. uvegoyim – chovtin oto veomrim lo: "ase ma sheyyisrael omrim lach" (vechasher).
Gemara amar rav nachman amar shemuel: get hameusse beyisrael, kaddin – kasher; shello kaddin – pasul, ufosel.
Uvegoyim, kaddin – pasul ufosel, shello kaddin – afillu reach hagget en bo.
Ma nafshach? i goyim bene assoye ninhu, ittachshore name littachshar! i lav bene assoye ninhu, mifsal la lifsol!
Amar rav mesharsheya: devar tora – get meusse baggoyim, kasher. uma taam amru pasul – shello tehe kol achat veachat holechet vetola atzmah begoy, vmafkaat atzmah miyyad balah.
I hachi, shello kaddin – afillu reach hagget en bo?! veneheve shello kaddin keyisrael, umifsal name lifsol!
Ella ha derav mesharsheya – beduta hi.
Vetama may? kaddin bechaddin deyisrael – michallaf. shello kaddin bechaddin [d]yisrael – la michallaf.

Abbaye ashkecheh lerav yosef deyatev veka measse aggitte, amar leh: veha anan – hedyotot anan, vetanya, haya rabbi tarfon omer: kol makom sheatta motze agoriot shel goyim, af al pi sheddinehem kedine yisrael – i atta rashshay lehizzakek lahem, shenneemar: "veelle hammishpatim asher tasim lifnehem"; "lifnehem" – velo lifne goyim. davar acher: "lifnehem" – velo lifne hedyotot!
Amar leh: anan – shelichutayyhu ka avdinan, midde dehave ahodaot vehalevaot.
I hachi, gezelot vechabbalot name! ki avdinan shelichutayyhu – bemilleta dishchicha, bemilleta dela shechicha – la avdinan shelichutayyhu.
Mishna yatza shemah bair "mekuddeshet" – hare zo mekuddeshet; "megoreshet" – hare zo megoreshet. uvilvad shello yehe sham amatla.
Ezo hi amatla? gerash ish peloni et ishto al tenay; zarak lah kiddusheha – safek karov lah, safek karov lo – zo hi amatla.
Gemara veasrinan la aggavra?! veha amar rav ashe: kol kala devatar nissuin – la chayyshinan leh!
Hachi kaamar: yatza shemah bair "mekuddeshet" – hare zo mekuddeshet. "mekuddeshet umegoreshet" –

a: Hare zo megoreshet. may tama? kol veshovro immo.
Amar rava: yatza lah shem mezanna bair – en choshshin lah. may tama? peritzuta bealma hu dachazo la.
Ketannae: achla bashshuk, girgera bashshuk, henika bashshuk – bechullan rabbi meir omer: tetze. rabbi akiva omer: mishsheyyisseu veyittenu bah mozrot ballevana.

Amar lo rabbi yochanan ben nuri: im ken, lo hinnachta bat leavraham avinu sheyyoshevet tachat baalah, vehattora amra: "ki matza vah ervat davar", ulehallan hu omer: "al pi shenayim edim o al pi shelosha edim yakum davar"; ma lehallan davar barur, af kan davar barur.
Tanu rabbanan: "beula" – en choshshin lah. "nesua" – en choshshin lah. "arusa" – en choshshin lah. "shello lifloni" – en choshshin lah. "beir acheret" – en choshshin lah.
"Mamzeret" – en choshshin lah. "shifcha" – en choshshin lah.
"Hikdish peloni nechasav"; "hifkir peloni nechasav" – en choshshin lahen.
Amar ulla: lo sheshshamu kol havara; ella kede sheyyehu nerot dolkot umittot mutztzaot, uvene adam nichnasin veyotzin veomrim: "pelonit mitkaddeshet hayyom".
"Mitkaddeshet"?! vedilma la ikkaddasha! ema: "pelonit nitkaddesha hayyom".

Vechen tane levi: lo sheyyishmeu kol havara; ella kede sheyyehu nerot dolkot umittot mutztzaot, venashim tovot leor hanner usemechot lah, veomrot: "pelonit mitkaddeshet hayyom". "mitkaddeshet"?! vedilma la ikkaddasha! amar rav pappa, ema: "pelonit nitkaddesha hayyom".

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: lo sheshshamu kol havara; ella kede sheyyehu nerot dolkot umittot mutztzaot, uvene adam nichnasin veyotzin. amru davar – ze hu kol, lo amru davar – zehu amatla.
Lo amru?! veha lo amru velo kelum! leappoke midderabba bar rav huna, deamar: amatla sheamru, afillu mikkan vead asara yamim. ka mashma lan – la amru, hu dehavya amatla; ha amru – la havya amatla.
Amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav: lo sheshshamu kol havara, ella kede sheyyomru: peloni mehechan shama? mippeloni; ufeloni mippeloni; uvodkin veholchin ad shemmaggiin ledavar habbarur.

Davar habbarur – edut meallayyta hu! ella ki ata rav shemuel bar yehuda, amar rabbi abba amar rav huna amar rav: lo sheshshamu kol havara, ella kede sheyyomru: peloni, mehechan shama? mippeloni; ufeloni mippeloni; vehalchu lahem limdinat hayyam.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: mevattelinan kala, o la mevattelinan? amar leh: middeamar rav chisda: ad sheyyishmeu mippi hakkesherim, shema minna: mevattelinan kala.
Amar leh: adderabba! middeamar rav sheshet: afillu mippi nashim have kol – shema minna: la mevattelinan kala!
Amar leh: atravota ninhu; besura mevatteli kala, binhardea la mevatteli kala.

Hahi dinfak ala kala deikkaddasha levar be rav, atyeh rav chama laavu, amar leh: ema li – hechi hava ovada? amar leh: al tenay kaddesh, addata dela azel leve chozay, vaazal. amar leh: kevan dividdana dahavay kala – la havay amatla, lav kol keminach demachzekat amatla.

Hahi dinfak ala kala, deikkaddasha baatzippa detuchela, beena deve shife". shalcha rav idi bar avin lekammeh deabbaye: ki hay gavvna may? amar leh: afillu leman deamar la mevattelinan kala, beha mevattelinan kala; memar amri: ayyinu behu rabbanan bekiddushe, vela hava behu shave peruta.
Hahi dinfak ala kala, deikkaddasha
b: Lechad mibbene pelanya, amar rava: afillu leman deamar la mevattelinan kala, beha mevattelinan kala; memar amri: ayyinu behu rabbanan bekiddushe, vekiddushe katan havo.

Hahi dinfak ala kala, deikkaddasha lekatan hannire kegadol. amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe: hava ovada, veamru: adayin lo higgia liflaggot reuven", shenneemar: "liflaggot reuven gedolim chikre lev".
Uvilvad shello tehe sham amatla: amar rabba bar rav huna: amatla sheamru, afillu mikkan vead asara yamim. rav zevid amar: bimkom amatla, choshshin laamatla.
Etiveh rav pappa lerav zevid: uvilvad shello tehe sham amatla! amar leh: bimkom amatla kaamar.
Amar leh rav kahana lerav pappa: veat la tisbera?! vehatnan: nitkaddesha, veachar kach ba balah – mutteret lachzor. lav mishshum deamrinan al tenay kaddesh?
Shane hatam, deate baal veka mearer.
I hachi, nisset name! nisset, daavada issura – kansuha rabbanan; nitkaddesha, dela avada issura – la kansuha rabbanan.

Amar rav ashe: kol kala dela ittachzak beve dina – lav kala hu. veamar rav ashe: kol kala devatar nissuin – la chayyshinan leh; ha devatar erusin – chayyshinan leh. rav chaviva amar: afillu devatar erusin name, la chayyshinan leh. vehilcheta: la chayyshinan leh.

Amar rav yirmeya bar abba: shelachu leh mibbe rav lishmuel, yelammedenu rabbenu: yatza aleha kol merishon, uva acher vekiddeshah kiddushe tora, mahu? shelach lehu: tetze, vehaamidu haddavar al bureyo, vehodiuni.

May "vehaamidu haddavar al bureyo"? illema dei miggalleya milleta dekiddushe dekamma lav kiddushe mealleya ninhu – mevattelinan kala; veha nehardea atreh dishmuel hu, vela mevatteli kala! ella dei miggalleya milleta dekiddushe kamma kiddushe mealleya ninhu – lo tzericha get mishsheni.
Ufeliga derav huna – deamar rav huna: eshet ish sheppashta yadah, vekibbela kiddushin meacher, mekuddeshet –
Midderav hamenuna; deamar rav hamenuna: haishsha sheamra levalah: "gerashtani" – neemenet, chazaka en ishsha meizza paneha bifne balah.
Veiddach – ki ittemar derav hamenuna, befanav; shello befanav – meizza umeizza.
Lo matzu davar al bureyo, mahu?
Amar rav huna: megaresh rishon, venose sheni. aval megaresh sheni venose rishon – la. may tama? ate lememar: machzir gerushato min haerusin.
Rav shinnana bereh derav idi amar: af megaresh sheni venose rishon, memar amri: ayyinu rabbanan bekiddushe, vekiddushe taut hava.
Yatza aleha kol mizze umizze, mahu? amar rav pappa: af zo – megaresh rishon venose sheni. ammemar amar: mutteret lishnehem.

a: Vehilcheta: mutteret lishnehem.
Mishna bet shammay omrim: lo yegaresh adam et ishto, ella im ken matza bah devar erva – shenneemar: "ki matza vah ervat davar".
Uvet hillel omrim: afillu hikdicha tavshilo – shenneemar: "ki matza vah ervat davar".
Rabbi akiva omer: afillu matza acheret naa hemenna – shenneemar: "vehaya im lo timtza chen beenav".
Gemara tanya, amru bet hillel levet shammay: vahalo kevar neemar "davar"! amru lahem bet shammay: vahalo kevar neemar "ervat"!

Amru lahem bet hillel: im neemar "ervat" velo neemar "davar" – hayiti omer: mishshum "erva" tetze, mishshum "davar" lo tetze; lechach neemar: "davar". veillu neemar "davar" velo neemar "ervat" – hayiti omer: mishshum "davar" – tinnase leacher, umishshum "erva" – lo tinnase leacher; lechach neemar: "ervat".
Uvet shammay – hay "davar" may avdi leh? neemar kan "davar", veneemar lehallan "davar" – "al pi shene edim o al pi shelosha edim yakum davar"; ma lehallan bishne edim, af kan bishne edim.
Uvet hillel – mi ketiv "erva bedavar"?! uvet shammay – mi ketiv "o erva o davar"?!
Uvet hillel – lehachi ketiv: "ervat davar"; demashma hachi, umashma hachi.
Rabbi akiva omer: afillu matza acheret: bemay ka mippalgi? bidresh lakish – deamar resh lakish: "ki" meshammesh bearbaa leshonot – i, dilma, ella, deha.
Bet shammay savri: "vehaya im lo timtza chen beenav, ki matza vah ervat davar" – deha matza vah ervat davar; verabbi akiva savar: "ki matza vah ervat davar" – i name, matza vah ervat davar.
Amar leh rav pappa lerava: lo matza bah lo erva velo davar, mahu?
Amar leh, middegalli rachamana gabbe ones: "lo yuchal leshallechah kol yamav" – kol yamav baamod vehachezer" kae; hatam hu degalli rachamana, aval hacha – may daavad avad.
Amar leh rav mesharsheya lerava: im libbo legarshah, vehi yoshevet tachtav umeshammashto, mahu? kare aleh: "al tacharosh al reacha raa vehu yoshev lavetach ittach".

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: keshem shehaddeot bemaachol, kach deot benashim. yesh lecha adam shezzevuv nofel letoch koso – vezorko, veeno shotehu; vezo hi middat pappus ben yehuda, shehaya noel bifne ishto veyotze.
Veyesh lecha adam shezzevuv nofel letoch koso – vezorko, veshotehu; vezo hi middat kol adam, shemmedabberet im acheha ukeroveha – umannichah.
Veyesh lecha adam shezzevuv nofel letoch tamchuy – motztzo, veochlo; zo hi middat adam ra, sheroe et ishto yotza veroshah parua, vetova bashshuk,
b: Uferuma mishshene tzedadeha, verochetzet im bene adam.
"Im bene adam" salka datach?! ella bimkom shebbene adam rochatzin.

Zo – mitzva min hattora legarshah, shenneemar: "ki matza vah ervat vegomer veshillechah mibbeto". "vehalcha vehayta leish acher" – hakkatuv kerao "acher", lomar: sheen ze ben zugo larishon – ze hotzi reshaa mibbeto, veze hichnis reshaa letoch beto.

Zacha sheni – shillechah, shenneemar: "useneah haish haacharon". veim lav – kovarto, shenneemar: "o chi yamut haish haacharon" – keday hu bemita; shezze hotzi reshaa mibbeto, veze hichnis reshaa letoch beto.
"Ki sane shallach" – rabbi yehuda omer: im senetah – shallach. rabbi yochanan omer: sanouy hameshalleach.
Vela peligi: ha bezug rishon, ha bezug sheni.

Deamar rabbi elazar: kol hamegaresh ishto rishona – afillu mizbeach morid alav demaot, shenneemar: "vezot shenit taasu, kassot dima et mizbach Adonai, bechi vaanaka meen od penot el hammincha, velakachat ratzon miyyedchem. vaamartem: al ma? al ki Adonai heid bencha uven eshet neurecha, asher atta bagadta bah, vehi chavertecha veeshet beritecha".
Hadaran alach hamegaresh uselika la massechet gittin

a: Haishsha niknet beshalosh derachim, vekona et atzmah bishte derachim. niknet bechesef, bishtar, uvevia. bechesef: bet shammay omrim bedinar uveshave dinar, uvet hillel omrim: bifruta uveshave peruta. vechamma hi peruta – echad mishshemona baissar haitalki.
Vekona et atzmah beget uvemitat habbaal. hayyevama niknet bevia, vekona et atzmah bachalitza uvemitat hayyavam.
Gemara haishsha niknet. may shena hacha detane "haishsha niknet", umay shena hatam detane "haish mekaddesh"? mishshum deka bae lemitne kesef,
Vechesef mena lan – gamar "kicha" "kicha" missede efron. ketiv hacha: "ki yikkach ish ishsha", uchetiv hatam: "natatti kesef hassade kach mimmenni",
Vekicha ikkeri "kinyan", dichtiv: "hassade asher kana avraham".
b: I name, "sadot bakkesef yiknu", tane "haishsha niknet".
Venitne hatam "haish kone"! meikkara tane lishshana deorayyta, ulevassof tane lishshana derabbanan, umay lishshana derabbanan? – deasar la akkulle alma kehekdesh.
Venitne hacha "haish kone"! mishshum deka bae lemitna sefa: "vekona et atzmah" bedida, tena name resha bedida.
Venitne "haish kone umakne"! mishshum deikka mitat habbaal, delav ihu ka makne – min shemayya hu demakni lah.
Vei baet ema: i tena "kone", hava amena afillu beal korchah – tena "haishsha niknet", demiddatah – in, shello middatah – la.
Umay irya detane "shalosh"? litne "shelosha"! mishshum deka bae lemitne "derech" vederech" leshon nekeva hu, dichtiv: "vehodata lahem et hadderech yelchu vah".

Veella ha detanya: "beshiva derachim bodkin et hazzav", nitne "sheva"! mishshum deka bae lemitne "derech", veashkechan "derech" deikkeri leshon zachar, dichtiv: "bederech echad yetzu elecha uveshiva derachim yanusu lefanecha". i hachi, kashu kerae ahadade! vekashya name matnitin ahadade!

Kerae ahadade la kashyayn: hacha, divtora kae, vetora ikkeri leshon nekeva, dichtiv: "torat Adonai temima meshivat nafesh" – katav lah bilshon nekeva. hatam, divmilchama kae, dedarko shel ish laasot milchama veen darkah shel ishsha laasot milchama – katav lah bilshon zachar.

Matnitin ahadade la kashyayn: hacha, dilgabbe ishsha kae – katane la bilshon nekeva. hatam, dilgabbe ish kae, dedarko shel ish libbadek veen darkah shel ishsha libbadek, deha ishsha name beones mittammeah – tane leshon zachar.
May tama tane "shalosh" – mishshum "derachim"? nitne "devarim" venitne "shelosha"! mishshum dekavae lemitne "bia", uvia ikkeri "derech", dichtiv: "vederech gever bealma ken derech ishsha menaafet".
Ha tinach "bia", "kesef" ushetar" may ikka lememar? mishshum "bia".
Vetane tarte attu chada? hanach name tzorech bia ninhu.

Vei baet ema: ha manni – rabbi shimon hi, detanya, rabbi shimon omer: mippene ma amra tora "ki yikkach ish ishsha", velo katav "ki tillakach ishsha leish"? – mippene sheddarko shel ish lechazzer al ishsha veen darkah shel ishsha lechazzer al ish. mashal leadam sheavda lo aveda – mi chozer al mi? baal aveda mechazzer al avedato.
Veha ditnan: "beshiva derachim bodkin et hazzav", litne "devarim"! hatam ha ka mashma lan, dedarka demechla yattira leetoye lide ziva, vedarka demishteya yattira leetoye lide ziva.
Veha ditnan: "etrog shave lailan bishlosha derachim", litne "devarim"! mishshum devaenan mitne sefa: "velayyarak bederech echad". sefa name, nitne "davar"!

a: Hatam ha kamashma lan, dedarkeh deetrog keyarak – ma yarak darko ligdal al kol mayim uvishat lekitato issuro, af etrog darko ligdal al kol mayim uvishat lekitato issuro.

Veha ditnan: "koy – yesh bo derachim shave lachayya, veyesh bo derachim shave labbehema, veyesh bo derachim shave lachayya velabbehema, veyesh bo derachim sheeno shave lo lachayya velo labbehema". nitne "devarim"! vetu, ha ditnan: "zo achat min hadderachim sheshshavu gitte nashim leshichrure avadim", nitne "devarim"!
Ella, kol hecha deikka pelugeta tane "derachim", vechol hecha delekka pelugeta tane "devarim". dayka name, dekatane sefa: "rabbi eliezer omer: etrog shave lailan lechol davar". shema minna.
Minyayna deresha lemaote may, minyayna desefa lemaote may?
Minyayna deresha – lemaote chuppa. ulerav huna, deamar chuppa kona mikkal vachomer, lemaote may?
Lemaote chalifin. salka datach amena, hoil vegamar "kicha" "kicha" missede efron – ma sade mikkanya bachalifin, af ishsha name mikkanya bachalifin, kamashma lan.
Veema hachi name! chalifin itanhu befachot mishshave peruta, veishsha befachot mishshave peruta
b: La makneya nafsha.

Minyayna desefa lemaote may – lemaote chalitza. salka datach amena: tete bekal vachomer miyyevama, ma yevama sheenah yotza beget – yotza bachalitza, zo, sheyyotza beget – eno din sheyyotza bachalitza? kamashma lan.
Veema hachi name! amar kera: "sefer keritut" – sefer kortah, veen davar acher kortah.
Bechesef. mena lan? vetu, ha ditnan: "haav zakkay bevitto bekiddusheha, bechesef bishtar uvevia", menalan demikkanya bechesef, vechesef daavu hu?
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: deamar kera "veyatza chinnam en kasef" – en kesef leadon ze, aval yesh kesef leadon acher. uman nihu – av.
Veema ledida! hachi hasheta?! aviha mekabbel kiddusheha, dichtiv: "et bitti natatti laish hazze", veihi shakla kaspa?!

Veema hane mille ketanna, delet la yad lekabbel kiddushin, aval naara, deit la yad lekabbel kiddushin – tekaddesh ihi nafshah vetishkol kaspa! amar kera: "binureha bet aviha" – kol shevach neurim leaviha.

Veella ha deamar rav huna amar rav: minnayin shemmaase habbat laav? shenneemar: "vechi yimkor ish et bitto leama", ma ama maase yadeha lerabbah – af bat name maase yadeha leaviha. tippok leh mibbinureha bet aviha"!
Ella, bahafarat nedarim hu dichtiv. hachi name, bahafarat nedarim hu dichtiv. vechi tema nelaf minneh – mamona meissura la yalfinan.
Vechi tema nelaf mikkenasa – mamona mikkenasa la yalfinan.
Vechi tema nelaf mibboshet ufegam – shane boshet ufegam daavu shayech begavvayyhu.
Ella, mistabbera dechi ka memaet –
